jobs.title: Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing (80 - 100%)

Olten |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8082

Möchtest du in einem dynamischen Team im Bereich Post-Trade Education & Client Testing arbeiten? Bist du eine kommunikative Persönlichkeit, welche über ein ausgeprägtes Kundenverständnis verfügt und auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen Kopf behält? Verfügst du über gute Kenntnisse der Börsen- und Wertschriftenwelt? Dann bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Post-Trade Education & Client Testing Team.

Als Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing unterstützt du unser Team in der Erstellung von E-Learning Kursen sowie bei der Planung und Durchführung von Präsenzkursen. Die Online- und Präsenzkurse richten sich an unsere Kunden und Mitarbeitende und vermitteln Wissen zu mehreren Bereichen der Wertschriftenwelt und zu diversen SIX Applikationen.

Im Client Testing verantwortest du die zentrale Koordination zwischen internen Stakeholdern und unseren Kunden und stellst eine abgestimmte Umsetzung der Testszenarien sicher. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Teamkollegen gewährleistest du, dass die Anliegen neuer und bestehender Kunden hinsichtlich Testing-Aktivitäten erfasst und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Die Training sowie Client Testing Aktivitäten umfassen diverse Fachbereiche von SIX wie z.B. Settlement, Corporate Action, Tax, Fonds, Clearing u.a.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Erstellung und Durchführung von Ausbildungsinhalten für Mitarbeitende und Kunden (E-Learning und Präsenzkurse) in verschiedenen Post-Trade-Fachbereichen wie Settlement, Corporate Actions, Tax etc. in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern.

• Durchführung von qualitativ hochstehenden und kundenorientierten Demo Sessions oder Präsentationen von Applikationen und Services, online oder an SIX Standorten, ggf. auch bei Kunden vor Ort

• Interne Schnittstelle für Client Testing Anfragen sowie zentrale Anlaufstelle zur Koordination und Ausführung von reibungslosen Client Testing Aktivitäten mit neuen sowie bestehenden Kunden

• Erstellen und Aktualisieren von Test Scripts für verschiedene Business Fachbereiche wie Corporate Action, Settlement, Clearing u.a.

• Regelmässiger Kundenkontakt, telefonisch wie schriftlich auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bringst du mit

• Zwingende, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Wertschriftenabwicklung und im Post-Trading Bereich, idealerweise Custody & Clearing (Settlement, Corporate Action, Clearing etc.), SWIFT Kenntnisse ebenfalls von Vorteil

• Aufgeschlossene und wortgewandte Persönlichkeit, welche gerne ihr Wissen vermittelt und sicher vor Publikum auftreten kann

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kunden sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kundenflair

• Belastbare und teamfähige Persönlichkeit die sich nicht scheut auch eigene Ideen einzubringen

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Level B2), Französisch und Italienisch sowie jede weitere Sprache ist von Vorteil

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Sei una personalità comunicativa che ha una forte comprensione del cliente e mantiene una testa fresca anche in tempi frenetici? Hai una buona conoscenza del mercato azionario e del mondo dei titoli? Quindi applicare e diventare parte del nostro team di test post-Trade Education & Client. Come specialista in post-Trade Education & Client Testing, supporterete il nostro team nella creazione di corsi di e-learning, nonché nella pianificazione e nell'implementazione di corsi faccia a faccia. I corsi online e faccia a faccia sono rivolti ai nostri clienti e dipendenti e impartiscono conoscenze su diversi settori del mondo dei titoli e varie applicazioni SIX. Nel test dei clienti, sei responsabile del coordinamento centrale tra gli stakeholder interni e i nostri clienti e assicura l'implementazione coordinata degli scenari di test. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i vostri compagni di squadra, assicuratevi che le preoccupazioni dei clienti nuovi e esistenti per quanto riguarda le attività di test siano registrate e implementate con successo. Le attività di formazione e test dei clienti includono diverse aree specializzate di SIX come Settlement, Corporate Action, Tax, Funds, Clearing e altre. Questi sono i tuoi compiti
• Creazione e implementazione di contenuti formativi per i dipendenti e i clienti (e-learning and face-to-face course) in vari settori soggetti post-commerciali come la composizione, azioni aziendali, tassa, ecc. in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni.
• Condurre sessioni demo di alta qualità e orientate al cliente o presentazioni di applicazioni e servizi, online o in località SIX, eventualmente anche presso i clienti in loco
• Interfaccia interna per le richieste di test dei clienti e punto di contatto centrale per il coordinamento e l'esecuzione di attività di test dei clienti fluidi con clienti nuovi ed esistenti
• Creazione e aggiornamento di script di test per varie aree di business come azione aziendale, regolamento, compensazione ecc.
• Contatto cliente regolare, telefono come scritto in tedesco e inglese Lo porti con te.
• Compulsory, diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel trattamento dei titoli e post-trading, idealmente Custodia & Clearing (Settlement, Corporate Action, Clearing ecc), SWIFT conoscenza anche benefica
• Personalità aperta e eloquente che ama impartire le loro conoscenze e può eseguire in modo sicuro davanti a un pubblico
• Esperienza nell'affrontare clienti esigenti e un tocco di cliente
• Personalità responsabile e di squadra che non ha paura di contribuire alle proprie idee
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura (livello minimo B2), francese e italiano e qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. jobs.title: Head Social Marketing
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Social Marketing

Zurich, Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8062

Are you passionate about shaping strategic social marketing at scale and leading teams through transformation? Do you thrive in an international, global environment and enjoy partnering closely with the business to create measurable impact? Then join our international Digital Communications team as Head of Social Marketing. The role can be based in Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or Zurich (Switzerland).

In this role, you will lead our social media team and own the strategic direction of paid and organic social marketing across our channels. With your leadership experience, strategic mindset, and drive for excellence, you will help strengthen our brands SIX and BME, elevate our social marketing maturity, and enable your team to act as trusted advisors to the business.

We invest in the development of our leaders and support you in continuously expanding your skills and capabilities.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead and coach a remotely distributed team of three social media specialists, fostering a strategic approach to social marketing, a consultancy mindset, accountability, and effective delegation.

• Own the end‑to‑end social marketing strategy across paid and organic activities, aligned with business and marketing objectives.

• Establish and continuously improve workflows and templates to ensure scalability, quality, and efficiency across remote collaboration.

• Act as the accountable owner for social marketing outcomes, translating goals into KPIs and measurable performance; includes leading crisis management across social channels when applicable.

• Act as a proactive strategic partner to internal stakeholders and propose solutions in resource‑constrained environments.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media, or a related field, with at least 6 years of relevant professional experience in social media marketing.

• Proven experience leading remote or virtual social media teams, with strong online leadership, coaching, and people development skills.

• Deep expertise in strategic social marketing, including paid campaigns, performance measurement, and optimization.

• Demonstrated ability to coach teams toward a consultative way of working, moving beyond purely executional delivery.

• Strong process and transformation mindset, with experience building scalable ways of working in complex organizations; fluent English is required, German language skills are highly preferred but not mandatory.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you.

We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes.

In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions.

Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot

• build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka

• develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly

• collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements

• ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems

What You Bring

• very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles

• experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices

• experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms

• knowledge of Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus

• experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases

• high english level, both writen and spoken, to interact with our international colleagues

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Ingénieur logiciel principal Varsovie : travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8037 Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement très dynamique et construire des systèmes de backend fiables et évolutives? Êtes-vous passionné par les architectures Java, les systèmes distribués et les événements ? Alors, notre équipe d'ingénieurs de Backend veut vous entendre. Nous sommes une équipe agile et collaborative chargée de concevoir et d'exploiter des services de base qui alimentent notre plateforme dans la zone Post Trading de la SIX Swiss Exchange. Notre objectif est de construire et de maintenir des systèmes robustes, évolutifs et durables qui soutiennent les processus opérationnels critiques. Dans cette position, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs logiciels, les architectes et les équipes de produits pour concevoir, entretenir et fournir des solutions de backend de haute qualité. Postulez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais. Ce que vous ferez
• concevoir, développer et maintenir des services de backend et des API REST en utilisant Java, Spring et Spring Boot
• construire et exploiter des services axés sur les événements en utilisant Apache Kafka
• développer et maintenir des applications fonctionnant sur des serveurs d'applications Java tels que WildFly
• collaborer avec des ingénieurs et des architectes sur la conception de systèmes, l'architecture et les améliorations techniques
• assurer la fiabilité, l'évolutivité et la performance des systèmes de production Ce que vous apportez
• très forte expérience avec le développement de backend Java et les principes modernes de conception de backend
• expérience avec Spring et Spring Boot pour la construction de microservices
• expérience avec Kafka ou d'autres plateformes de messagerie / flux d'événements
• la connaissance de Wildfly/JBOSS est un grand plus
• expérience de conception d'API RESTful et de travail avec des bases de données SQL
• haut niveau d'anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé, pour interagir avec nos collègues internationaux Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645 Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code)

Warsaw, Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7548

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code) to join our Software Engineering Practice Team.  Your mission: shape how AI transforms the way software gets built at SIX from idea to production code powering the financial markets in Europe and beyond. In this role you define the vision and strategy, design the architecture, evaluate suitable solutions and drive their adoption. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and developer tooling, the internal development platforms and organizational change - putting agentic AI into the hands of product owners, business analysts, architects, testers and developers across the company.

What You Will Do

• Own the AI roadmap for the Software Development Lifecycle — from requirements and design through development and deployment

• Continuously evaluate, benchmark and assess the latest AI tools and platforms

• Prototype and integrate AI-powered workflows when off-the-shelf solutions don't fit, using modern agent frameworks

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI-enabled solutions by designing rollout strategies, running pilots and workshops and tracking measurable adoption outcomes

• as a first project engineer and rollout Claude Code for the Developers

What You Bring

• passion for AI and re-imagining software development

• 5+ years in software engineering and demonstrated experience in Claude Code

• strong understanding of the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle

• hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI Agents

• ability to drive adoption of new tools and practices across engineering teams, not just make them available

• strong communication and presentation skills, fluent in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Software Engineer

Zurich |  80-100 % | Referenz 7792

Der Name «debiX» spricht für sich, denn die Zusammensetzung von «debit» und «experience» zielt auf unsere gemeinsame Ambition: Wir vereinfachen das Bezahlen für die Schweiz.

Als zentrale Plattform ermöglicht debiX mit Apple- und Google-Pay zu bezahlen, Interaktion durch mobile Apps, Erkennung von Kartenbetrug und weitere innovative Lösungen für die Kartenverwendung der Zukunft. Mit deinem Fachwissen leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag für die Entwicklung einer modernen Plattform. Durch den DevOps-Ansatz gewährleisten wir die hohe Stabilität unserer Services.

Bei uns zählt Offenheit, Zusammenarbeit und eine positive Fehlerkultur. Werde Teil unseres agilen Teams und gestalte mit, wie ein grosser Teil der Schweizer Bevölkerung bezahlt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern und Stakeholdern konzipierst und implementierst du komplexe Features für den Schweizer Finanzplatz und übernimmst dabei End-to-End-Verantwortung (Design bis Betrieb)

• Du bringst dich aktiv in die technische Lösungsarchitektur ein und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen zu Design, Technologien und Integrationsmustern

• Als erfahrenes Mitglied eines selbstorganisierten Scrum Teams treibst du die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Entwicklungsprozessen, Architektur und Zusammenarbeit voran

• Du lebst den DevOps-Gedanken und übernimmst Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb

• Du stellst durch Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests und Best Practices eine hohe Softwarequalität sicher und wirkst aktiv an deren Weiterentwicklung mit

• Du unterstützt und coachst weniger erfahrene Entwickler und förderst aktiv Wissenstransfer sowie Engineering Excellence im Team und teamübergreifend

• Du arbeitest aktiv und beratend mit an querschnittlichen Themen wie Architektur, Security, Devops und Betrieb

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit modernen Java- und Web-Technologien sowie im Design von skalierbaren Systemen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur (z. B. Microservices, event-driven Architektur, REST APIs) und Best Practices über den gesamten Software Development Lifecycle

• Erfahrung mit CI/CD, DevOps-Prinzipien und Container-Plattformen (z. B. OpenShift/ Kubernetes)

• Fähigkeit, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und diese nachvollziehbar zu begründen und festzuhalten

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, andere zu coachen und Wissen zu teilen

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen, geschäftskritischen Systemen, idealerweise im regulierten Umfeld (z. B. Finanzindustrie) von Vorteil

• Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Angular oder vergleichbaren Frameworks, Event Streaming (z. B. Kafka), sowie Observability/Monitoring

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Mateusz Kozielec  unter der Nummer +41583998611.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Writer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7879

As a Documentation Specialist (Technical Writer), you support participants of the electronic trading and listing platforms of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME) and SIX Swiss Exchange. In close collaboration with subject‑matter experts, you prepare clear, timely communications for technical contacts at trading participants and maintain documentation products for internal and external clients. You also handle related administrative tasks. The role requires the ability to quickly understand complex topics, particularly when delivering fast and reliable information in emergency situations. You work independently and with a high degree of reliability in a complex operational environment

We are seeking a Technical Writer with a Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field. The position is full-time position (100%) based in Madrid and involves close collaboration with the Documentation Team in Zurich. Willingness to travel is required.

What You Will Do

• Create and distribute technical notices addressed to participants of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME), SIX Swiss Exchange (SSX), SIX Exfeed, 12H and CONNEXOR.

• Support communication tasks during emergency notifications during exchange trading hours and on weekends during trading platform migrations.

• Create and maintain technical documentation to support the technical help desks of these services.

• Perform various internal documentation tasks, including creating, reviewing, and finalizing documents using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Adobe Designer.

• Publish content and maintain the Member Section.

What You Bring

• Strong experience in technical writing, document lifecycle management, and structured content creation.

• Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Adobe Designer; Knowledge of SAP CRM and Confluence and expericence with SAFe / Agile project management methodologies is an advantage.

• Excellent English skills; Spanish and German language abilities are considered strong advantages.

• Able to translate complex technical concepts into clear and concise content for various audiences. Solid knowledge of IT‑related topics and familiarity with financial market infrastructure.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and version control. Ability to work reliably under time pressure, including support during trading hours and occasional weekend duties.

• Strong interpersonal skills for collaborating with IT teams, product owners, and operational units.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Madrid |  Flexible Working Model | Reference 8084

If your answer is yes, our team responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

jobs.title: Accounting Specialist
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounting Specialist

Madrid |  Working form home up to 40% | Reference 8094

Are you passionate about finance? Do you have very good analytical skills to assess complex accounting issues under IFRS and Spanish GAAP? Do you have experience working in a multinational Group? If yes, this is the right place for you.  As an Accounting Specialist you will be part of the General Ledger team in Spain. Your tasks will consist of processing and supervising daily business activities (accounting entries, mapping of interface data, reconciliation, etc.) of the entities of the SIX Group located in Spain and France. You will contribute to monthly / quarterly / annual closing activities and reporting of said entities and work closely with different departments and locations (in particular headquarter in Switzerland) to ensure that the financial statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS, Spanish GAAP and SIX’s standards.

Does it sound interesting for you? Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• independently process and supervise daily business and period-end closings. Prepare individual and consolidated financial statements (Cuentas Anuales), and other relevant financial and activity reports (CNMV) of the Spanish and French entities of the SIX Group.

• prepare internal reporting and support Group consolidation process. Develop and implement the accounting policies of BME and new applicable IFRS standards and/or services in line with the SIX Group accounting policies

• assess complex accounting matters under Spanish GAAP, IFRS, and other applicable legislation

• contribute to and/or lead strategic projects (e.g. restructuring, due diligence processes, PPAs, first consolidation of newly acquired companies or businesses, divestments, financial integration, impairment, etc.)

What You Bring

• university Degree in Business Administration and advanced education in Finance & Accounting (e.g. certified auditor)

• 4 years minimum experience in financial audit (Big 4 or consultancy sector preferably) or in a similar position related with accounting or financial reporting including month-end closing activities in an international Group operating in different locations

• in-depth expertise in Spanish GAAP, IFRS and consolidation. Knowledge about internal control systems and procedures will be highly valued

• good command of Excel and knowledge of SAP. Any experience with reporting tools (e.g. SAC, Power-BI) will be an advantage

• resilient, responsible, proactive, independent and honest personality interested in working on a customer-oriented team and open to work in a multi-cultural environment, having also strong analytical, time-management, communication and coordination skills

• proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Spécialiste en comptabilité Madrid: formulaire de travail à domicile jusqu'à 40%. Référence 8094 Êtes-vous passionné par la finance ? Avez-vous de très bonnes compétences analytiques pour évaluer des questions comptables complexes dans le cadre des IFRS et des GAAP espagnols? Avez-vous de l'expérience dans un groupe multinational? Si oui, c'est le bon endroit pour vous. En tant que spécialiste de la comptabilité, vous ferez partie de l'équipe General Ledger en Espagne. • traiter et superviser de façon indépendante les opérations quotidiennes et les clôtures de fin d'exercice. Préparer des états financiers individuels et consolidés (Cuentas Anuales) et d'autres rapports financiers et d'activités pertinents (CNMV) des entités espagnoles et françaises du Groupe SIX.

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounting Internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8093

Would you like to grow in a dynamic environment and learn how an accounting department operates? Then our team wants to hear from you!
We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for the statutory and regulatory reporting of the BME Group and its subsidiaries. Our goal is to optimize financial resources and ensure efficient reporting and accuracy of financial data. • Support the implementation of financial processes and controls

• Assist in performing accounting entries

• Help with reporting to the regulator

• Interest in learning and developing in the financial sector

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and similar tools

• Fluent English (both verbal and written); other languages are a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cloud Data Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7590

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Account Manager

Frankfurt |  bis zu 40% Home Office | Reference 7979

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between technology and customer success? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your technical and data expertise and client-facing skills make a real impact? Then we want to hear from you! We are a collaborative sales-driven team responsible for delivering tailored data services to key clients in Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe. In this role, you will work closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for strategic and major clients for all technical coordination and 2nd level support, issue resolution, and rollout of development requests

• Support clients in enhancing existing services

• Trusted consultant and advisor for customers and be the go-to-person for all financial data content questions

• Coordinate and track usage metrics, development requests, and ensure timely communication between internal teams and clients

• Coordinate sub-contractors/partners

• Support upgrades and migrations

What You Bring

• Technical background with solid understanding of IT systems, data structures, interfaces and/or integration processes, ideally within banking or investment platforms

• Min. 3 years’ experience in technical account management or technical project management, preferably in the financial services industry

• Excellent customer orientation and communication skills with the ability to translate technical topics into business language and comprehensive understanding of the German financial market

• Strong organizational / project management skills with experience working in agile development environments is a plus

• Collaborative team player with a commercial mindset and an ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in German (C2) and English (C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What We Offer

Flexible Work Models

We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Personal Development

You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de support de poste de travail IT

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• 2.4+ anni di esperienza in supporto IT in loco o scrivania di servizio IT (livello 1/2) in ambienti aziendali
• forti competenze pratiche in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Team, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)
• esperienza pratica con supporto hardware e rotolo strutturato
• solida comprensione di Active Directory / Azure AD e attività Intune di base

• esperienza in ambienti di grandi imprese
• sapere come intorno Microsoft Teams Rooms e la tecnologia sala riunioni

jobs.title: Senior Security Platforms Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Security Platforms Engineer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629

Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale?

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations.

Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams.

The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential.

What You Will Do

• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.

• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.

• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.

• Develop and maintain  Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.

• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally.

What You Bring

• Core expectations (senior level):

• Strong experience in  platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .

• Proven expertise in  Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .

• Practical experience working with  Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.

• Experience with  data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.

• Strong production mindset: experience with  on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations. Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams. The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential. What You Will Do
• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.
• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.
• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
• Develop and maintain Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.
• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally. What You Bring
• Core expectations (senior level):
• Strong experience in platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .
• Proven expertise in Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .
• Practical experience working with Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.
• Experience with data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.
• Strong production mindset: experience with on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. .buttontextc3db959

titleByLocale.fr: Analyste en solutions - Service des actifs IT

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT

Olten |  100% | Reference 7804

Are you passionate about working in IT within the financial industry and enjoy collaborating closely with both business and IT stakeholders? In this role, you will design and shape solutions in close partnership with the business and technology teams, using your strong communication and organizational skills. Join our Asset Services IT team and help deliver impactful solutions within the Corporate Actions domain.

What You Will Do

• Proactively liaise with business and product management teams to identify improvements and opportunities

• For new projects and changes prepare scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions based on the business requirements

• Stakeholder management and communicate milestones to the stakeholders

• Prepare solution documents for IT to start development, guide the IT development

• Prepare test case that development team can use to test the new development

• Testing and analyzing the developed code to ensure it meets business requirements and follows all development guidelines and standards

What You Bring

• Relevant professional experience (10+ years) in IT Development along with Solution design.

• Working knowledge in COBOL and Java (Spring Boot framework) & Asset servicing/Corporate Actions business knowledge/experience is required

• Understanding of SWIFT Messaging MT/MX Standard

• Should have the capability to learn new tools and IT concept, as well as set priorities, good trouble shooting skills and high motivation

• Very good knowledge in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point etc. Should be also comfortable with Jira

• Very good communication skills in English, German would be a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud

Barcelona, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7624

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational excellence drive everything we do? Are you eager to learn, bring new ideas, and tackle challenges in a modern DevOps setup? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer focused on automated cloud deployments and container platforms. In this role, you will support development teams by designing and operating Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, automating infrastructure and deployment processes, providing standardized CI/CD pipelines, and configuring shared operational services. Working with tools like Kubernetes, OpenShift, Argo CD, GitLab, Ansible, and container registries, you will help build scalable release processes, improve deployment reliability, and ensure consistent ado

ption of DevOps and GitOps best practices.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain automated deployment workflows for containerized applications in Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Manage GitOps processes using Argo CD and GitLab CI/CD, including rollout strategies and configuration management.

• Implement Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Helm, Terraform/Ansible) for consistent and auditable changes.

• Work with application and infrastructure teams to onboard and standardize services on Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks for reliable operations.

• Contribute to cluster upgrades, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

• Develop and support CI/CD pipelines, reusable automation templates, and onboarding materials.

• Assist teams with pipeline integration, secrets management, and observability.

• Document standards and promote DevOps best practices.

What You Will Bring

• Experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, especially with Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Strong skills in Python, shell scripting, GitLab CI/CD, and Argo CD.

• Knowledge of Infrastructure‑as‑Code, preferably with Ansible and Helm.

• Solid understanding of Linux, networking, and containerization concepts.

• Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk).

• Strong troubleshooting skills in microservices environments.

• Clear communication skills with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Fluency in English; German or Spanish is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de la sécurité de l'information commerciale

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Information Security Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7942

Information security is a key requirement for the successful and compliant operation of Securities Services. As a Business Information Security Officer (BISO), you act as the main point of contact for information security topics within Securities Services, supporting the appropriate handling of security risks, regulatory obligations, and internal security requirements in line with SIX standards.
In this role, you work closely with business, IT, and security stakeholders to ensure that information security requirements are well understood and applied in a pragmatic and business‑oriented manner. You support initiatives and day‑to‑day activities by providing guidance, facilitating alignment between parties, and contributing to a consistent security approach across the organization.
You will collaborate with central security teams, IT, legal, risk, and compliance functions, and be part of the wider BISO community within SIX.

We are looking forward to hear for you. Please apply with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Act as a key contact and advisor for information security topics within the assigned business area, supporting managers and key stakeholders

• Advise and support projects, applications, and initiatives in implementing information security requirements in line with SIX standards and best practices

• Contribute to the identification, assessment, and handling of information security risks affecting the business area

• Facilitate effective collaboration between business, IT, and security functions to ensure pragmatic and proportionate security solutions

• Support the interpretation and application of regulatory, contractual, and internal security requirements (e.g. data protection, industry standards)

• Contribute to security awareness, reporting, and continuous improvement activities, and actively participate in the SIX BISO community

What You Bring

• 4 years of professional experience in information security, IT risk, IT, or a related field. Relevant training or certification in information security will be a plus

• Good understanding of information security principles, risk management, and control concepts with ability to understand technical security topics and communicate them clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services is an advantage

• Structured and solution‑oriented working style, with attention to detail

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a pragmatic and service‑oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple topics in parallel and work effectively with a range of stakeholders

• Fluency in English and Spanish (both written and spoken)  German is an advantage but not mandatory

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801

At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives?

This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly

• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems

• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox

• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading

• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner

What You Bring

• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services

• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist with German
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Operations Specialist with German

Warsaw |  up tp 40% working from home possible | Reference 7770



As a key contributor to our sales operations, you will manage a defined customer territory in close collaboration with a Sales Representative. You will also take ownership of all administrative and support activities related to sales and the implementation of financial information systems for our clients.

What You Will Do

• Territory Management: Oversee a customer sales territory in partnership with Sales and Account Managers, focusing on financial services products in Swiss German and German customers

• Client Service: Serve as a primary point of contact for customer inquiries related to products, functionalities, data, pricing, exchange permissions, and issue resolution

• Contract Administration: Draft, process, and manage customer contracts within the financial customer information system

• Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiate invoicing processes and monitor dunning procedures and accruals to ensure financial accuracy

• Project Coordination: Manage product and data entitlements, and plan, coordinate, and track customer and sales-related projects from initiation to completion

What You Bring

• at least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a middle or back-office environment

• strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail

• customer-focused with a proactive and well-organized approach

• ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment

• language Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in  English and German

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst - Market Data & Entitlements (with French)

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7630

Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of market data? As part of a team of specialists you will help build and operate reliable market data and entitlement flows for French Products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). You will analyze and specify requirements for pricing and reference content sourced from MDF Stream/MDF Select, IPS and some direct contributors. You will ensure this content is normalized, high quality, and distributed to all French Products and clients with the correct licensing and access controls. Working closely with product, engineering, operations, and QA, you’ll translate MDF and IPS specifications and market rules into clear, testable documentation that enables accurate data delivery. You will occupy a central position between two data models (Global and FR) that allow French products to fully benefit from the rich market data of the global model.

What You Will Do

• Gather and document the functional and non-functional requirements of real-time and end-of-day price data feeds, as well as the repositories provided by MDF and IPS, to cover all the needs of French products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). Define the standardization, enrichment, and validation rules.

• Design and maintain entitlement models and content distribution rules for French products, ensuring compliance with provider licensing and contractual constraints.

• Support onboarding and certification of new/changed feeds from MDF and IPS. Coordinate test scenarios, ensure their validation and non-regression across the entire system.

• Investigate incidents and drive corrective actions with providers and internal teams.

• Contribute to market data documentation & standards and process improvements across all delivery channels for French Products (MDF, IPS, Finalim, PGD, Europerf, and TDI for entitlement).

What You Bring

• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in market data or financial information.

• Strong understanding of market data concepts, normalization, and data quality controls.

• Experience with market data providers and feeds. Knowledge of access rights frameworks and models, data distribution flows, and licensing obligations.

• Ability to translate business rules into technical specifications and test cases; solid documentation skills.

• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; familiarity with APIs and file-based delivery; comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, QA, and operations.

• Exposure to agile methods (e.g., Jira/Azure DevOps) and quality assurance practices (UAT, regression).

• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655

Join us in shaping the future of financial information. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade AI solutions. If you are passionate about agentic AI, enjoy solving hard engineering problems, and want to see your work used daily by real users in a critical products, this is a unique opportunity to have a tangible impact from day one.

What You Will Do

• Architect Multi-Agent Systems: Design, build, and orchestrate complex agentic workflows using LangGraph and LangChain to handle sophisticated financial queries and agents.

• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.

• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors.

• Implement Advanced RAG: Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems to ground model responses in proprietary data.

• Establish Evaluation Pipelines: Create rigorous testing frameworks and metrics to evaluate agent performance, reliability, and accuracy in a production environment.

What You Bring

• Core AI Engineering Stack: Deep expertise in Python and the modern AI stack, including LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, and Hugging Face Transformers. Strong ability to debug and optimize multi-agent workflows, with a focus on asynchronous execution, state management, and concurrency.

• API & Data Proficiency: Experience designing and integrating with complex REST/GraphQL endpoints and handling structured data formats (JSON/XML) for tool calling.

• Cloud & DevOps Mindset: Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) for deploying production-grade AI applications.

• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in software Engineering including significant experience in as a Gen AI Application Developer. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior AI Backend Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as a Senior AI Backend Engineer of our Productization squad. You will own the backend, APIs, and integrations that turn AI prototypes into production-grade products in our GenAI and Data Mining lines. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade engineering, partner with data scientists and AI engineers on serving and integration patterns, and free the AI Solutions team to focus on models and evals while your squad owns reliable delivery to end users What You Will Do
• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.
• Design & Build Production APIs: Architect and maintain endpoints and GraphQL APIs, defining schema, resolver, and authentication patterns that serve frontend applications, internal services, and AI features.
• Integrate Data & AI Pipelines: Develop ingestion, parsing, OCR, and vendor-LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with strong attention to concurrency, async processing, retries, idempotency, and state-machine workflows.
• Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . • Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Integration Manager

Zurich |  Working from home up 40% | Referenz 8087

Möchtest du an der Schnittstelle von Banking Services, Technologie und Kundenintegration arbeiten? Motiviert es dich, Banken, Partner und interne Teams dabei zu unterstützen, sichere und stabile Services produktiv zu nutzen?

Dann freut sich unser SIX BBS Team, von dir zu hören. Wir sind verantwortlich für das Onboarding, die technische Integration und den operativen Support von Services wie DebiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit und bLink. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit Banken, Kunden, Softwarepartnern, Vendoren, IT-Partnern sowie internen Teams wie Product, IT, Security, Compliance und Operations zusammen. Dein Fokus liegt auf technischen Integrationen, Kunden-Onboarding, Testing, Go-live Vorbereitung, 2nd Level Support und einer sauberen Übergabe in den regulären Betrieb.

Dies ist keine reine Projektmanager-, Product-Owner- oder Software-Engineering-Rolle. Es ist eine zentrale Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Kunden, Technologie und Betrieb.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du koordinierst technische Integrationsprojekte für DebiX API und weitere BBS Services wie eBill, Debit und ATM – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zum Go-live und zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.

• Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Banken, Kunden, Softwarepartner, Vendoren, IT-Partner und interne Teams während Onboarding, Testing, Abnahme und Produktionsvorbereitung.

• Du klärst fachliche, technische und operative Anforderungen für API-basierte Integrationen, Kundenanbindungen, Zertifikate, Umgebungen und Supportprozesse.

• Du unterstützt Testvorbereitung, Testdurchführung, Fehleranalyse, Kundenabnahmen, Go-live Aktivitäten, Hypercare und die Übergabe in den regulären Betrieb.

• Du übernimmst 2nd Level Support für Kundenanfragen, technische Schnittstellenthemen, Zertifikate, Integrationsprobleme und produktionsrelevante Incidents.

Das bringst du mit

• Erfahrung in technischer Kundenintegration, API-Integration, Partner-Onboarding, Service Integration oder technischer Projektkoordination, idealerweise im Banking, Zahlungsverkehr oder einem regulierten Umfeld.

• Gutes Verständnis von REST APIs, XML, JSON, Authentisierung, Zertifikaten, mTLS, OAuth oder vergleichbaren Sicherheits- und Schnittstellenthemen.

• Erfahrung mit Testing, Abnahmen, Go-live Vorbereitung, Incident Handling, 2nd Level Support, Service Management und operativer Übergabe.

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich für Banken, Kunden, Business Teams, IT-Partner und Vendoren zu erklären.

• Strukturierte, pragmatische und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Kundenorientierung;

• Sprache: sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch oder Italienisch sind von Vorteil.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Mateusz Kozielec  unter der Nummer +41583998611.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi. Gestione dell'integrazione Zurich | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8087 Vuoi lavorare all'interfaccia dei servizi bancari, della tecnologia e dell'integrazione dei clienti? Ti motiva a sostenere banche, partner e team interni nell'utilizzo di servizi sicuri e stabili? Allora il nostro team di SIX BBS è lieto di sentirvi. Siamo responsabili dell'integrazione tecnica e del supporto operativo di servizi come DebiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit e bLink. In questo ruolo, si lavora a stretto contatto con banche, clienti, partner software, fornitori, partner IT e team interni come prodotto, IT, sicurezza, conformità e operazioni. L'attenzione è rivolta alle integrazioni tecniche, al customer onboarding, al collaudo, alla preparazione del go-live, al supporto del secondo livello e al trasferimento pulito alle operazioni regolari. Questo non è un puro ruolo di project manager, proprietario del prodotto o ingegneria del software. È un ruolo di interfaccia centrale tra clienti, tecnologia e operazioni. Oppure puoi usare il nostro assistente AI tool à Job Description Wizard (https://chatgpt.com/g/g-hEE2ZiXq6-job-description-wizard) Questi sono i tuoi compiti
• Coordinate i progetti di integrazione tecnica per DebiX API e altri servizi BBS come eBill, Debit e ATM – dal coordinamento iniziale al go-live e al trasferimento al funzionamento.
• Sei la persona di contatto centrale per banche, clienti, partner software, venditori, partner IT e team interni durante la preparazione di bordo, test, accettazione e produzione.
• Sarà necessario chiarire i requisiti tecnici, tecnici e operativi per integrazioni basate su API, connessioni dei clienti, certificati, ambienti e processi di supporto.
• Supporti la preparazione del test, l'esecuzione del test, l'analisi degli errori, l'accettazione del cliente, le attività di go-live, l'ipercare e il trasferimento al funzionamento regolare.
• Si prende il supporto di secondo livello per le richieste dei clienti, argomenti di interfaccia tecnica, certificati, problemi di integrazione e incidenti rilevanti per la produzione. Lo porti con te.
• Esperienza nell'integrazione tecnica dei clienti, integrazione API, integrazione dei partner, integrazione dei servizi o coordinamento tecnico del progetto, idealmente nelle operazioni bancarie, di pagamento o in un ambiente regolamentato.
• Buona comprensione delle API REST, XML, JSON, autenticazione, certificati, mTLS, OAuth o simili argomenti di sicurezza e interfaccia.
• Esperienza con test, accettazione, preparazione go-live, gestione degli incidenti, supporto di secondo livello, gestione dei servizi e consegna operativa.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di spiegare i problemi tecnici in modo comprensibile per banche, clienti, team aziendali, partner IT e venditori.
• Metodi di lavoro strutturati, pragmatici e affidabili con un elevato orientamento del cliente;
• Lingua: ottime competenze in tedesco e inglese, francese o italiano sono vantaggiose. Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Mateusz Kozielec su +41583998611. Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.

• Experience in technical customer integration, API integration, partner onboarding, service integration or technical project coordination, ideally in banking, payment transactions or a regulated environment.
• Good understanding of REST APIs, XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, mTLS, OAuth or similar security and interface topics.
• Experience with testing, acceptances, go-live preparation, incident handling, 2nd level support, service management and operational handover.
