jobs.title: HR Consultant with German
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

HR Consultant with German

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7875

Are you ready to take on a dynamic role that combines personnel management with hands-on HR advisory and coaching for managers and employees?

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced professional with strong expertise in HR consulting who is passionate about making an impact. If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply for the position of HR Consultant.

In this role, you will report to the Head of HR Advisory in Switzerland and collaborate with international HR consultants to support managers and employees located in Switzerland.

What You Will Do

• provide guidance and support to managers and employees based in Switzerland on HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle (recruitment, assessment, development, retention, transfer, etc.)

• ensure proper execution of HR processes to mitigate risk, while actively identifying workflow inefficiencies and driving continuous improvement

• collaborate with HRBP’s, HR Centers of Expertise and the HR Service Center to deliver cohesive and aligned HR solutions that meet business needs

• manage a variety of administrative and coordination tasks to support seamless HR operations

• coordinate and implement the annual compensation review process within the assigned area of responsibility

• work in partnership with both team members in Switzerland and global HR teams and departments, actively contributing to the implementation of Swiss and global HR projects and initiatives

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• at least 5 years of professional experience in HR consulting or personnel management, including a minimum of 2 years working in an international HR environment, supporting European-based staff, preferably in Switzerland

• strong track record in consulting, with demonstrated problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal communication skills

• proven ability to function within an international matrix structure and manage diverse cultural dynamics

• proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), particularly SAP SuccessFactors

• excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a strong advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks)

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7582

Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as the Lead Data Platform Engineer of our  Data Platform & Analytics  squad. You will own the roadmap and evolution of our Data Science Platform on Azure and Databricks the self-service foundation that data scientists, analysts, business analysts, and AI engineers across the organization rely on to turn complex financial data into production-ready insights.

This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.

• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.

• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.

• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.

• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases.

What You Bring

• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.

• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.

• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.

• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).

• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Working Student Team Support - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%)

Zurich |  40-60% | Reference 8105

Are you looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience alongside your studies to challenge yourself in an international environment? Then join our Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance team at SIX, a leading financial market infrastructure provider serving the Swiss financial center.

As a Working Student, you will gain valuable insights into the day-to-day work of Enterprise Architecture and IT Governance while supporting communication initiatives, coordination activities, documentation, and operational processes. This role offers hands-on experience and exposure to a wide range of topics at the intersection of business and IT. We provide a supportive working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth, along with the option for a Membership in the SIX NextGen Community.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to communication initiatives related to Enterprise Architecture and prepare materials such as presentations, stakeholder maps, and communication frameworks

• Support operational processes in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) including the maintenance and structure of data and documentation

• Prepare presentations by structuring data and translating it into visualizations and management summaries

• Organize internal events (e.g. Architecture Day and workshops)

• Coordinate meetings, including scheduling and participant alignment

What You Bring

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field

• Strong organizational and communication skills with a structured way of working

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel

• Fluent in English and German; Spanish is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling  at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Supporto per il Team Studente di Lavoro - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%) Zurigo | 40-60% | Riferimento 8105 Stai cercando un'opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica accanto ai tuoi studi per sfidarti in un ambiente internazionale? Poi unisciti al nostro team Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance di SIX, un fornitore leader di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario che serve il centro finanziario svizzero. Come studente di lavoro, acquisirai preziose informazioni sul lavoro quotidiano di Enterprise Architecture e IT Governance, supportando iniziative di comunicazione, attività di coordinamento, documentazione e processi operativi. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica e l'esposizione ad una vasta gamma di argomenti all'incrocio tra business e IT. Forniamo un ambiente di lavoro di supporto con opportunità di crescita personale e professionale, insieme con la possibilità di un membro nella Comunità SIX NextGen. Cosa farai
• Contribuire alle iniziative di comunicazione relative all'architettura aziendale e preparare materiali come presentazioni, mappe degli stakeholder e framework di comunicazione
• Supporta i processi operativi in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) tra cui la manutenzione e la struttura dei dati e della documentazione
• Preparare le presentazioni strutturando i dati e traducendolo in visualizzazioni e sintesi di gestione
• Organizza eventi interni (ad esempio Giornata dell'Architettura e workshop)
• Coordinare le riunioni, compresa la programmazione e l'allineamento dei partecipanti Che cosa porta
• Attualmente perseguire una laurea o Master in Informatica aziendale, Business Administration, comunicazioni, o un campo correlato
• Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione con un modo strutturato di lavorare
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire più attività contemporaneamente
• Proficienza in Microsoft Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel
• Fluente in inglese e tedesco; lo spagnolo è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Janine Reichling al numero +41 58 399 42 99 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: Senior Software Analyst & Developer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Analyst & Developer

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As a Software Analyst & Developer, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments.

• Native Spanish and advanced level of English (C1), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Partecipa alle attività di supporto al di fuori delle ore di lavoro, compresa la risoluzione di incidenti ad alta priorità che interessano le operazioni di compensazione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali, le operazioni e i team di rischio per garantire un funzionamento efficiente e conforme dei servizi di Clearing.
• Contribuisci alla ri-architettura, all'analisi e allo sviluppo della piattaforma di compensazione di nuova generazione, supportando l'integrazione e il consolidamento dei sistemi di compensazione europea in un ecosistema unificato. Che cosa porta
• Forte competenza nei database Oracle e sviluppo avanzato di PL/SQL, con comprovata esperienza nell'elaborazione e nell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni complesse.
• Sfondo solido in applicazione e architettura di sistema, soprattutto in ambienti legacy complessi.
• La comprensione del dominio business Clearing sarà un plus
• Esperienza con Java (architettura dei microservizi) e ambienti Linux.
• Spagnolo nativo e livello avanzato di inglese (C1), sia scritto che parlato.
• Disponibilità per svolgere attività di supporto pianificate al di fuori dell'orario di lavoro standard, quando necessario. Questo e' extra compensato.
• Volontà di partecipare a una rotazione di supporto 24/7 on-call, che copre settimane complete (circa una settimana al mese) e per coprire alcune festività bancarie (prox. 6 all'anno). • Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis des Ökosystems für Clearing-Anwendungen, einschließlich Kerngeschäftsflüssen, Datenmodellen und Systemabhängigkeiten.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an Support-Aktivitäten außerhalb der Geschäftszeiten, einschließlich der Lösung von Vorfällen mit hoher Priorität, die sich auf Clearing-Operationen auswirken.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Architekten und Ingenieurteams zusammen, um Legacy-Systeme zu entwickeln und zu Modernisierungsinitiativen und der Integration in neue Architekturen (z. B. Microservices) beizutragen.
• Tragen Sie zur technischen Dokumentation, zum Wissensaustausch und zu Übergabeprozessen bei und gewährleisten Sie langfristige Wartbarkeit und Teamautonomie.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Geschäftsbetrieben und Risikoteams, um einen effizienten und konformen Betrieb der Clearingdienste sicherzustellen.
• Beitrag zur Neuarchitektur, Analyse und Entwicklung der Clearing-Plattform der nächsten Generation, um die Integration und Konsolidierung europäischer Clearing-Systeme in ein einheitliches Ökosystem zu unterstützen. Was du mitbringst

• Forte expertise dans les bases de données Oracle et le développement avancé PL/SQL, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le traitement de données complexes et l'optimisation des performances.
• Fond solide dans l'architecture de l'application et du système, en particulier dans les environnements anciens complexes.
• La compréhension du domaine d'activité de Clearing sera un plus
• Expérience des environnements Java (architecture microservices) et Linux.
• Espagnol autochtone et niveau avancé d'anglais (C1), à la fois écrit et parlé.
• Disponibilité pour effectuer les activités de soutien prévues en dehors des heures de travail normales, au besoin. C'est une compensation supplémentaire.

• Bereitstellung von 1st-Level-Unterstützung (Überwachung, Triage, Softwarebereitstellung usw.)
• Bereitstellung von 2nd Level Support (Application Troubleshooting)
• Implementieren Sie Automatisierung für spezifische Aufgaben und Prozesse
• Interagieren Sie mit IT-Anwendungen und Business-Teams Was du mitbringst
• Bachelor-Abschluss oder Hochschulzertifikat in Informationstechnologie oder ähnlich
• Advanced OS Wissen (Linux und Windows)
• Containerisiertes Anwendungsmanagement (OCP/K8S)
• DevOps-Praktiken und Werkzeugverständnis werden wertvoll sein
• Automatisierungserfahrung (Ansible, CI/CD, etc.) wird ebenfalls positiv berücksichtigt
• Bereitschaft, an einem rotierenden Zeitplan zu arbeiten, einschließlich morgens bis nachmittags Schichten

Êtes-vous enthousiaste à l'égard de projets passionnants dans le secteur financier et aimeriez-vous travailler dans un environnement autoorganisé où la collaboration, la confiance et l'innovation sont primordiales? • Fournir un soutien de premier niveau (surveillance, triage, déploiement de logiciels, etc.)
• Fournir un support de 2ème niveau (dépannage de l'application)
• Mettre en œuvre l'automatisation pour des tâches et des processus spécifiques
• Interagir avec l'application informatique et les équipes d'affaires Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat ou certificat d'enseignement supérieur en technologie de l'information ou similaire
• Connaissance avancée de l'exploitation (linux et fenêtres)
• Gestion des applications conteneurisées (OCP/K8S)

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Application Engineer (100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8017

You are enthusiastic about exciting projects in the financial industry, you enjoy working with internal and external interfaces and you are good at managing IT systems? Then become part of our IT team.

What You Will Do

• develop, maintain, and support IT applications in the Connectivity Area for Post Trading using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Integration, and related frameworks. Collaborate closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into effective solutions, and communicate clearly across different stakeholder groups

• ensure smooth IT operations (3rd Level application support) and incident management within SLA requirements, including ITSM processes, service desk activities, problem resolution, and participation in a rotating on-call (picket) support schedule (approx. once every 4–6 weeks) using Jira and Confluence.

• implement and deploy new releases across Development, Test, and Production environments (OCP, Linux), leveraging CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab, Maven, JFrog.

• adhere to architectural, security, and compliance standards throughout the development lifecycle, utilizing best practices and tools like SonarQube and XRAY.

• drives continuous improvement in application SLAs, monitoring, and automation by leveraging, Grafana, Elastic, Ansible and proactively managing technical debt.

• interacts with other stakeholders: Application Architects, Solution Designers, Project Teams and Developers

What You Bring

• 9-14 years of hands-on experience in software development, application maintenance, and production support, with a strong commitment to resolving critical issues.

• solid experience in Java technologies (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate) and with relational databases such as Oracle and MS SQL.

• proficiency with modern DevOps and automation tools, including Git, Maven, Helm 3, Ansible, and Argo CD.

• experience in C/C++ is a plus

• ability to thrive in fast-paced, agile environments, demonstrating flexibility to work outside normal hours when needed to support production.

• excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) are required; domain knowledge of banking or post-trading services is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Equity Commercial Department Internship
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Equity Commercial Department Internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8021

Are you interested in learning about Capital Markets and financial sector? On this internship, you will have the opportunity to be part of our BME Equity Primary Market Department. This is a dynamic team in charge of the contact with our main clients: issuers and investors. On this team you will be able to participate and provide commercial support for meetings with investors and other forums that are organized to serve listed issuers and collaborate in the daily basis of the department.

What You Will Do

• collaborate in the organization of BME Corporate Access Events, MedCap Forum – Latibex Forum - All caps Conference

• analysis, selection and invitation of European institutional investors for these events. For this, the Nasdaq IR Insight system that we have contracted at BME is used

• help in the organization of different roadshows with European listed companies

• collaborate in the tasks of identifying potential listed companies for the elaboration of the commercial plan for attracting companies

• updating pertinent data in the CRM, configuration of reports and sending of communications

• work in coordination of all the necessary tasks for the department between the different teams: Web team, Communication, BME Growth, etc

What You Bring

• studies in business administration, finance, capital markets, marketing, public relations or something related

• good knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PPT)

• high customer orientation and dedication to service

• constructive and responsible attitude with analysis capacity oriented to work with diverse teams and under pressure for deadlines

• fluency in English verbal & written (B2 level minimum)

• knowledge about the functioning of the market in all its phases will be valued: trading, settlement, dissemination of information, etc

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA Automation Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7922

Do you want to work in an agile, self-organized environment where collaboration, trust, and innovation are paramount? Are you passionate about testing and test automation? Are you eager to upskill making us of AI. Then, apply now and become part of the Securities Finance IT department.

We are looking for a QA Test Automation Engineer who shares this enthusiasm. You will play a crucial role to uplift the speed and quality of our deliveries by solving technical challenges and implementing new tests with cutting edge technologies and frameworks. You act across teams with a focus on end-to-end responsibility.

What You Will Do

• Contribute on integrating AI in the Test Case Life Cycle and QA process

• Develop test strategies designed to improve software quality and test coverage

• Guild, improve, migrate and maintain our test suites and pipelines

• Investigate, triage, and troubleshoot software defects

• Identify opportunities to automate testing and data management using a variety of tools and techniques

What You Bring

• Proven experience as a QA Automation Engineer and demonstrated ability to design and implement effective test strategies and test cases.

• Experience using programming languages (Java, JavaScript), experience in Linux and the use of DevOps tools and pipelines with GitLab/GitHub, Docker, OpenShift / Kubernetes.

• Deep understanding and practical experience with test tools / frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Junit, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with AI tools in coding is a plus (ClaudeCode, Copilot)

• Good communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively within a team as well as fluent in English and Spanish.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

titleByLocale.fr: Exploitation des SIC des étudiants en travail 60-70 %

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Working Student SIC Operations 60-70%

Zurich |  60-70% | Referenz 8012

Du möchtest neben deinen Studium erste Berufserfahrungen sammeln und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität des Schweizer Finanzplatzes leisten? Du bist ein/e administrative/r Allrounder/in? Dann freuen wir uns von dir zu hören! Du  unterstützt dabei SIC Operations bei deren administrativen Aufgaben inkl. Überwachung und Durchführung von Schlüsselaustauschprozessen, damit unsere Teilnehmer auch in den Migrationsphasen testen und unterbruchfrei arbeiten können. Du kannst auch in Projekten mitarbeiten, führst Statistiken und Auswertungen und bist da, wo Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Als modernes, dynamisches und innovatives Unternehmen bieten wir eine Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten, dein Potenzial in der spannenden Welt von Technologie und Finanzen zu entfalten. Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Berufseinstieg, investieren in deine Entwicklung und die Erweiterung deiner persönlichen Fähigkeiten. Als «Working Student» bis du Teil unserer NextGen Community und bist Teil eines Netzwerks von engagierten Career Starter.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Durchführung von Schlüsselaustauschprozessen zur Sicherstellung sicherer Kommunikationskanäle

• Verwaltung und Pflege der Teilnehmerstammdaten

• Bearbeitung von Formularen (Online, PDF) inkl. Prüfung der eingehenden Formulare der Teilnehmer

• Anpassungen der Webseiten und SIC-Sharepoint

• Allgemeine administrative Unterstützung im Team

Das bringst Du mit

• Aktuelles Studium vorzugsweise im wirtschaftlichen Umfeld

• Technisches Verständnis oder hohe IT-Affinität von Vorteil

• Hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft

• Team-Player mit viel Freude am Kundenkontakt

• Ausgeprägte MS Office Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Französisch ist ein Plus

• Wohnhaft in der Schweiz (aufgrund der Zugriffe auf produktive Systeme)

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Janine Reichling  unter der Nummer +41 58 399 42 99.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Application Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Bis zu 40 % Homeoffice möglich | Referenz 7943

Du brennst für erstklassige User Experiences und hast ein Auge für modernes Design? Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team sowie agilen Umfeld und bringst Leidenschaft für intuitive Benutzeroberflächen, performante Frontend-Architekturen und die nahtlose Integration von Java-Backends mit?

Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse.

In deiner Rolle als Senior Application Engineer gestaltest du moderne, reaktionsschnelle User Interfaces und verbindest diese nahtlos mit robusten Java-Backends. Die Entwicklung modularer Frontend-Komponenten sowie die Sicherstellung einer erstklassigen User Experience gehören zu deinem Alltag. Du trägst massgeblich dazu bei, die Brücke zwischen Design und Technik zu schlagen, Client-Performance zu optimieren und durchgängige Continuous Delivery-Prozesse zu fördern – für maximale Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Code-Qualität.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du bist ein Senior Software Engineer und coding macht dir Spass. Das gilt natürlich auch für Requirement Engineering, Applikations-Design, Unit-Testing und was sonst noch dazugehört.

• Unsere Fullstack Webentwicklung bietet dir grossen Aktionsradius. Dabei liegt der Hauptfokus auf dem User Interface, das unsere Kunden und internen MA nutzen, daneben wirst du auch einige der Services betreuen, die von unseren integrierten Kunden genutzt resp. im Terravis-System verwendet werden.

• Du wirst dir Know-How des gesamten Terravis-Systems aneignen, um deine Entwicklungsarbeit effizient zu erfüllen und für Support-Aufgaben optimal gerüstet zu sein, dazu gehört auch das im Einsatz befindliche proprietäre UI-Framework, auf dem das Terravis User Interface basiert.

``

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung und 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Java-Anwendungen: Java J2EE, HTML, Javascript, JQuery, XML, JAXB, SOAP

• Umfassende Praxiserfahrung in modernem UI Framework (z. B. Angular, Spring MVC/UI, React)

• Web-Services (Spring, REST etc.); Data management (SQL, Spring data, JPA etc.)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Sicherer Umgang mit Entwicklungswerkzeugen (z. B. IDEA IntelliJ, Maven, Openshift, GitLab, SoapUI etc)

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Mateusz Kozielec  unter der Nummer +41583998611.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Full-Stack Developer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7935

As part of the IT organization serving the Financial Information business unit, we are continuously improving our customers' and internal users' experience.

Our team is developing and operating the applications which manage the licensing of our data sets towards both our clients and suppliers. We are using state-of-the-art technologies for every stage of our systems.

Are you passionate about modern technology and solving problems? Do you want to work in an agile, self-organized environment where collaboration, trust, innovation and continuous improvement are paramount? Then, our motivated software development team wants to hear from you.

What You Will Do

• develop and maintain software across the full development lifecycle

• collaborate with product owners and team members to deliver solutions

• ship high-quality, well-reviewed code within deadlines

• support production systems & have on-call responsibilities

• participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience with Java, Spring, Rest APIs, SQL.

• backend knowledge is a must with an educated opinion on best practices and design topics.

• experience with container platforms (e.g. Openshift), DevOps tools for CI/CD (e.g. Gitlab) and observability (e.g. Grafana).

• frontend knowledge in React would be an advantage

• strong sense of quality through integration tests and unit tests.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Expert
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Tax Expert

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7955

Are you interested in working in a highly dynamic environment with international tax exposure? We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Specialist to join our Group Tax / Tax Management team in Spain. This role requires a self-driven professional who independently manages key tax matters, including tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory support to the group on topics such as restructurings and acquisitions. A particular focus lies on FATCA and QI compliance, where deep expertise and practical experience are essential. Beyond this, you will cover a wide spectrum of responsibilities within an international tax function.

What You Will Do

• Own and manage FATCA and QI compliance processes, including reporting, controls, and coordination with key stakeholders such as the tax operations teams in Switzerland

• Oversee EU DAC obligations, ensuring accurate data validation, documentation, and regulatory submissions

• Act as a tax business partner to BSS Business Units, providing advisory support on products, services, and operational tax matters

• Collaborate closely with Swiss and Spanish teams to align processes and ensure consistent tax governance standards

• Support transfer pricing topics, including data preparation, documentation, and coordination with internal experts

• Take responsibility for corporate tax compliance and tax reporting across relevant entities

• Contribute to tax planning initiatives and provide support on group-wide projects, including restructurings and M&A activities

• Provide comprehensive tax advice on a broad range of international and local tax matters within the group

What You Bring

• Degree in Tax, Business, or Economics with hands-on experience in FATCA, QI, and tax compliance frameworks

• Solid experience in international or regulated environments with exposure to EU or US tax reporting obligations

• Ability to work independently with structured and reliable approach in compliance-driven environments

• Strong communication skills to collaborate across teams and explain complex tax matters to internal and external stakeholders clearly

• Needed Language Skills: English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Client Onboarding & Platform operations (Financial regulatory technology)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7966

Do you like turning incidents, client pain and operational complexity into better products and stronger platforms? Join our RegTech team in a hybrid role between Product, Engineering, Operations, Support and Clients.

Our RegTech SaaS solutions support financial institutions with Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance. As AI-augmented delivery increases change velocity, we need strong operational product ownership to ensure resilience, monitoring, security, onboarding efficiency and client delivery improve systematically - not ad hoc.

What You Will Do

• Own and prioritize the backlog for platform operations, monitoring, resilience, onboarding tooling and technical client delivery.

• Translate incidents, support cases, client requests and due-diligence questions into structural improvements.

• Work with Engineering and Platform teams to improve observability, maintainability, automation an operational robustness.

• Support RFPs, DORA/security questionnaires and technical discussions with clients.

• Define requirements for internal tools that reduce manual effort and key-person dependency.

• Bridge Product, Support, Engineering, Sales and Clients with clear priorities and practical execution.

• Level 2 support for complex technical issues and help translate recurring incidents, onboarding frictions and reliability concerns into better monitoring, testing, documentation and platform improvements.

What You Bring

• Strong technical reasoning across Linux, logs, SQL, APIs, data flows and production systems.

• Experience owning backlogs, writing clear requirements and prioritizing across competing needs.

• Client-facing credibility on technical, operational or regulatory topics.

• Ability to spot patterns in operational work and convert them into scalable solutions.

• Structured communication, pragmatic judgment and a bias for repeatability and simplification.

• Very good English; Spanish, German or French are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7965

Do you enjoy leading complex client onboardings where trust, clarity and execution matter? Join our RegTech team and help financial institutions successfully adopt SaaS solutions for Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance. This is a senior customer-facing role with a strategic focus on DACH clients. You will work with compliance, operations, IT and business stakeholders, coordinating internally with Product, Engineering, Support and Sales. As our platforms evolve faster through AI-augmented delivery, human trust, expectation management and delivery credibility become even more important.

• Lead complex customer onboardings from planning to successful production adoption.

• Serve as a reliable escalation point for client questions and issues, ensuring timely resolution, clear communication and proper assessment of root causes and impact.

• Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Support and Sales to ensure clear commitments and reliable delivery.

• Understand client workflows, data requirements, operational constraints and regulatory expectations.

• Support demos, RFPs, client workshops and service reviews with credible product and operational knowledge.

• Identify recurring customer pain points and help turn them into product, process or tooling improvements.

What You Bring

• Strong client-facing experience with financial institutions, ideally in SaaS, RegTech, market data or financial technology.

• Professional-level German and fluent English; Spanish or French are an advantage.

• Ability to build trust with compliance officers, IT teams, operations specialists and senior stakeholders.

• Structured project and onboarding management skills.

• Calm authority, ownership mindset and excellent communication in complex situations.

• Interest in financial markets, regulation, technology and long-term customer success

jobs.title: IT DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT DevOps Engineer

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7856

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational robustness are key principles?
Are you motivated to learn, grow your technical skills, and contribute to modern DevOps practices while working alongside experienced engineers?
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
We are looking for an Application Ops Engineer to join our Operations Team and support application development teams through automation, standardized CI/CD pipelines, and the configuration of shared operational platforms.
In this role, you will contribute to building and operating scalable deployment and automation solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with tools such as GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow, and Python, and collaborating closely with developers and platform teams to ensure operational quality and Operations best practices across the application lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCD

• Develop, adapt, and maintain reusable automation templates using Ansible

• Support development teams in integrating deployment pipelines, workflows, and observability configurations

• Assist in the operation and improvement of scheduling and workflow automation platforms such as Airflow

• Write and maintain Python scripts to support automation, integrations, and operational tasks

• Help drive standardization, security, and scalability in build and deployment workflows

• Collaborate with central infrastructure teams on provisioning, upgrades, and shared platform services (e.g. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Document processes, configurations, and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Learn and apply modern DevOps tooling and practices, sharing knowledge within the team

What You Bring

• A strong interest in DevOps and automation across the software delivery lifecycle

• Hands-on experience or practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, or similar tools

• Basic experience with Python for scripting or automation purposes

• Familiarity with Linux environments and application deployments

• Exposure to observability or monitoring tools such as Grafana, ELK, Prometheus is a plus

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and collaborate in a cross-functional environment

• Proactive mindset, good communication skills, and a team-oriented attitude

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Platform Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7967

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape the platform behind mission-critical RegTech SaaS solutions used by financial institutions? Join our RegTech team and help us scale the reliability, resilience and delivery capacity of our Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance platforms.

We are evolving towards an AI-augmented engineering model, where software delivery becomes faster and platform governance, automation, observability and security become even more important. In this role, you will work peer-to-peer with senior engineers to make sure our platform can safely support that next level of change.

What You Will Do

• Co-own the RegTech platform across Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD, Linux systems, databases, observability and release processes.

• Design and improve scalable, secure and repeatable infrastructure for production and non-production environments.

• Strengthen deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, runbooks and incident response capabilities.

• Drive platform improvements around resilience, performance, security, vulnerability management and compliance readiness.

• Collaborate with software engineering, support and product teams to turn operational risks into structural improvements.

• Promote documentation, automation and knowledge sharing to reduce key-person dependency.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift, Linux, CI/CD, containers and automation.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, networking, security and production failure modes.

• Experience operating business-critical platforms in regulated, financial or high-assurance environments.

• Good judgment: you know when to move fast, when to simplify and when to challenge a risky change.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA & Testing Governance Lead

titleByLocale.fr: AQ et test de gouvernance Responsable

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA & Testing Governance Lead

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7940

If you have strong experience in QA and Test Management, combined with a structured mindset and the ability to align diverse teams around common standards, we would welcome you to join us as QA & Testing Governance Lead within Securities Services IT at SIX.
This role is part of the Program & Service Management function and is responsible for defining and driving common QA and testing governance, standards, and best practices across Securities Services IT. While Test Managers and testing roles are embedded in the different vertical areas, this position ensures a shared “common ground” and consistent quality governance across the organization.
Depending on needs and priorities, the role may also include acting as Test Manager in selected projects within the vertical areas, combining strategic governance responsibilities with hands on delivery involvement.

Does it sound interesting to you? We are looking forward to meeting you. Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Define, maintain and evolve QA and Testing governance, standards and best practices for Securities Services IT, with a strong focus on enabling shift‑left quality practices in close collaboration with engineering teams.

• Establish and maintain a common reference model for test phases, entry/exit criteria, go live quality gates and production readiness expectations.

• Act as the central coordination point for Test Management practices, fostering alignment and reuse of proven approaches across the different vertical areas.

• Define and standardize quality metrics, KPIs and reporting, enabling transparency, comparability and data driven decision making.

• Drive alignment of testing and test automation practices and tooling, favoring enablement models (e.g. shared baselines, self‑service approaches) over purely top‑down enforcement, while balancing standardization with context‑specific needs.

• Contribute, when required, as Test Manager in concrete initiatives or projects, supporting test planning, defect governance and go live readiness.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of hands‑on experience in QA, Test Management or Quality Governance in complex IT environments (regulated or mission‑critical contexts are a strong advantage).

• Proven experience defining and rolling out standards, governance models, processes and metrics across multiple teams or units.

• Strong understanding of test phases, testing strategies, entry/exit criteria, defect management and production readiness.

• Solid knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools and evidence‑based quality reporting, including metrics that help connect quality outcomes with delivery performance.

• Location in Spain, with willingness to travel occasionally to Switzerland.

• Fluent English (mandatory); Spanish highly valued; German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7860

Our centralized Software Development LifeCycle platform, based on GitLab and JFrog Artifactory, provides core capabilities to software developers across SIX.  We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to maintain and evolve our GitLab platform and enhance our GitLab components with related tooling, that empower product teams across the organization to increase efficacy and code quality.

What You Will Do

• take a leading role in maintaining and evolving our corporate SIX GitLab platform running in Azure

• design, implement, and manage GitLab components and configurations (groups, projects, runners, pipelines, templates, shared libraries)

• build and maintain shared CI/CD pipelines, reusable templates, automations and best-practice patterns for delivery at scale

• implement and maintain GitLab Runners (Kubernetes, autoscaling, Docker, Shell) with enterprise-grade reliability and security

• drive continuous improvement through automation, AI solutions, self-service capabilities and feedback loops

• create documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement materials; deliver training and provide Tier 2/3 support for GitLab and related tools

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with focus on GitLab administration and CI/CD. Experience with GitLab Premium or Ultimate features is a plus

• proficiency with CI/CD concepts: branching strategies, pipeline as code, artifacts, environments, approvals, and compliance controls

• hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes),  deploying/scaling GitLab Runners on K8s, Prometheus and Grafana

• familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, Helm) and configuration management (Ansible or similar). Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python or similar)

• strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work cross-functionally

• team-player with good verbal and written skills in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Specialist Settlement (80%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 7912

Hast du Freude daran, komplexe Finanzprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und sicherzustellen, dass auch Ausnahme-Situationen effizient gelöst werden? Das Team Settlement Special Services gewährleistet zentrale Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertschriftenabwicklung bei SIX SIS. Im Bereich Exception Handling übernehmen wir die Überwachung und Verarbeitung aller non-STP-Swift-Meldungen sowie verschiedener Kontrollreports. Mit einer proaktiven Steuerung unserer Prozesse und Risiken stellen wir einen zuverlässigen Betrieb und einen hohen Servicelevel sicher.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine(n) SpezialistIn Settlement, die/der Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Verantwortung und ein dynamisches Umfeld mitbringt. Wir bieten dir eine spannende, vielseitige Position mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice. Mindestens drei Arbeitstage pro Woche verbringst du im Büro – wahlweise in Zürich oder Olten. Ein gemeinsamer Teamtag pro Woche findet fix in Olten statt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Koordination und Kommunikation mit internen und externen Schnittstellen, darunter Network Management, Depotstellen in verschiedenen Ländern, ICSDs, CSDs, Client Relationship Manager, Corporate Actions, Valorenstammdaten und Reconciliation

• Zeitgerechte Verarbeitung von non-STP Swift-Nachrichten (MT54x) von über 50 Ländern

• Investigation und Korrekturverbuchung von Reconciliationbreaks

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Abwicklungsabläufe sowie Pflege und Weiterentwicklung

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung; idealerweise mit Banklehre oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation

• Fundiertes Fachwissen im Wertschriftenbereich, sowie praktische Erfahrung im Tagesgeschäft; mehrjährige Erfahrung im Settlement ist wünschenswert

• Teamorientierte, engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Eigeninitiative und klarer, adressatengerechter Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie hohe Zuverlässigkeit und ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle

• Coordinamento e comunicazione con interfacce interne ed esterne, tra cui gestione della rete, uffici di deposito in diversi paesi, ICSD, cps, client-cottage manager, azioni aziendali, master data e riconciliazione

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry.  This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced.  This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

•    Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
•    Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

ServiceNow Platform Architect

Warsaw |  Flexible hybrid model | Reference 7831

Do you want to shape how ServiceNow is used across the enterprise to drive transformation? We are looking for a ServiceNow Platform Architect to join our CIT team in Warsaw. In this role, you will take a key role in shaping and governing the ServiceNow architecture in a greenfield environment, with direct influence on how the platform is built and evolves across the organization.

You will design scalable cross-module solutions and drive standards, governance and best practices across the platform, ensuring a secure, compliant and future-ready setup in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architecture as part of a structured design authority, playing a central role in building a strong and sustainable platform foundation in a complex enterprise landscape.

What You Will Do

• Accountable for the overall stability, performance and security of the ServiceNow platform.

• Ensure the ServiceNow platform architecture aligns with business strategy and delivers secure, scalable and future-ready solutions.

• Define and maintain the long-term technical platform roadmap release plan.

• Identify opportunities to maximize value from ServiceNow investments and improve service delivery through automation and standardization.

• Define platform and data architecture standards, patterns and documentation, ensuring design consistency and data integrity across the platform.

• Guide teams through solution design, technical delivery and environment strategy, ensuring alignment with architectural standards.

• Enforce technical governance across the platform through defined standards and design authority practices.

• Design cross‑module solutions across ITSM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD and related platform capabilities, ensuring end-to-end consistency and overseeing integrations.

• Define and own the CMDB and service modelling strategy (CSDM), and oversee CMDB health.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating business requirements into effective ServiceNow solutions and clearly communicating architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Drive solution direction in close collaboration with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architect, ensuring alignment with governance, security and overall platform strategy.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, ideally within regulated enterprise environments.

• Over 8 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience in complex organizations with demanding compliance and audit requirements.

• ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – mandatory.

• Strong understanding of ServiceNow implementation strategies and best practices.

• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – preferred.

• CTA or CMA certifications – preferred.

• Experience with AI – a strong plus.

• Experience with Git – preferred.

• Proven ability to design secure and compliant integrations, as well as enterprise-scale workflows.

• Experience designing CMDB models integrated with BMC Discovery in complex enterprise environments and governance frameworks – preferred.

• Ability to contribute to Design Authority reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance and platform strategy – a strong plus.

• Experience in highly regulated environments – preferred.

• Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken). German language skills – preferred.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. ServiceNow Soluzione Architetto Varsavia | Modello ibrido flessibile | Riferimento 7831 Vuoi modellare come ServiceNow viene utilizzato in tutta l'azienda per guidare la trasformazione? Stiamo cercando un ServiceNow Platform Architect per unire il nostro team CIT a Varsavia. In questo ruolo, si assumerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nel governo dell'architettura ServiceNow in un ambiente greenfield, con influenza diretta su come la piattaforma è costruita ed evolve in tutta l'organizzazione. Progetterai soluzioni cross-module scalabili e standard di azionamento, governance e best practice in tutta la piattaforma, garantendo una configurazione sicura, conforme e futura in un ambiente regolamentato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il proprietario della piattaforma e l'architettura aziendale come parte di un'autorità di progettazione strutturata, svolgendo un ruolo centrale nella costruzione di una solida e sostenibile piattaforma di fondazione in un complesso paesaggio aziendale. Cosa farai
• Contabile per la stabilità complessiva, le prestazioni e la sicurezza della piattaforma ServiceNow.
• Garantire l'architettura della piattaforma ServiceNow si allinea alla strategia aziendale e offre soluzioni sicure, scalabili e future.
• Definire e mantenere il piano di rilascio roadmap della piattaforma tecnica a lungo termine.
• Identificare le opportunità per massimizzare il valore degli investimenti di ServiceNow e migliorare la consegna dei servizi attraverso l'automazione e la standardizzazione.
• Definire gli standard, i modelli e la documentazione della piattaforma e l'architettura dei dati, garantendo la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati della piattaforma.
• Guide team attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni, la consegna tecnica e la strategia ambientale, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard architettonici.
• Rafforzare la governance tecnica attraverso standard definiti e pratiche di autorità di progettazione.
• Soluzioni cross-module di progettazione in ITSM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD e relative funzionalità della piattaforma, garantendo la coerenza end-to-end e supervisionando le integrazioni.
• Definire e possedere la strategia CMDB e di modellazione dei servizi (CSDM), e supervisionare la salute CMDB.
• Agire come consulente di fiducia traducendo i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni ServiceNow efficaci e comunicare chiaramente le decisioni architettoniche e i trade-off a stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Guidare la soluzione in stretta collaborazione con Platform Owner e Enterprise Architect, garantendo l'allineamento con la governance, la sicurezza e la strategia globale della piattaforma. Che cosa porta
• Corso di laurea in Informatica, IT o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente, idealmente all'interno di ambienti aziendali regolamentati.
• Oltre 8 anni di esperienza di ServiceNow pratico in organizzazioni complesse con requisiti di conformità e audit esigenti.
• Certificazioni ServiceNow come CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – obbligatorie.
• Forte comprensione delle strategie di implementazione di ServiceNow e delle migliori pratiche.
• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – preferito.
• Certificazioni CTA o CMA – preferite.
• Esperienza con AI – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza con Git – preferito.
• Prova capacità di progettare integrazioni sicure e conformi, così come flussi di lavoro su scala aziendale.
• Esperienza progettando modelli CMDB integrati con BMC Discovery in ambienti aziendali complessi e framework di governance – preferito.
• Capacità di contribuire alle recensioni di Design Authority, garantendo l'allineamento con l'architettura aziendale, la governance e la strategia di piattaforma – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza in ambienti altamente regolamentati – preferito.
• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese (scritta e parlata). Le competenze linguistiche tedesche – preferite. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645 Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. Traduzione:

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. ServiceNow Solution Architekt Warschau | Flexibles Hybridmodell | Referenz 7831 Möchten Sie gestalten, wie ServiceNow unternehmensweit genutzt wird, um die Transformation voranzutreiben? Wir suchen einen ServiceNow Platform Architect, der unserem CIT-Team in Warschau beitritt. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung und Steuerung der ServiceNow-Architektur in einer Greenfield-Umgebung, mit direktem Einfluss darauf, wie die Plattform aufgebaut ist und sich im gesamten Unternehmen entwickelt. Sie werden skalierbare modulübergreifende Lösungen entwerfen und Standards, Governance und Best Practices auf der gesamten Plattform vorantreiben, um eine sichere, konforme und zukunftsfähige Einrichtung in einer regulierten Umgebung zu gewährleisten. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Platform Owner und der Enterprise Architecture als Teil einer strukturierten Designbehörde zusammen und spielen eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau einer starken und nachhaltigen Plattformbasis in einer komplexen Unternehmenslandschaft. Was Sie tun werden
• Verantwortlich für die allgemeine Stabilität, Leistung und Sicherheit der ServiceNow-Plattform.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die ServiceNow-Plattformarchitektur mit der Geschäftsstrategie übereinstimmt und sichere, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Lösungen liefert.
• Definieren und pflegen Sie den langfristigen Roadmap-Release-Plan für die technische Plattform.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, den Wert von ServiceNow-Investitionen zu maximieren und die Servicebereitstellung durch Automatisierung und Standardisierung zu verbessern.
• Definieren Sie Plattform- und Datenarchitekturstandards, Muster und Dokumentation, um die Konsistenz des Designs und die Datenintegrität auf der gesamten Plattform zu gewährleisten.
• Führen Sie Teams durch Lösungsdesign, technische Lieferung und Umweltstrategie, um die Ausrichtung auf architektonische Standards sicherzustellen.
• Erzwingen Sie die technische Governance auf der gesamten Plattform durch definierte Standards und Design Authority Practices.
• Entwerfen Sie modulübergreifende Lösungen für ITSM-, CMDB-, IRM/GRC-, CSM-, HRSD- und verwandte Plattformfähigkeiten, um eine durchgehende Konsistenz zu gewährleisten und Integrationen zu überwachen.
• Definieren und besitzen Sie die CMDB- und Service-Modellierungsstrategie (CSDM) und überwachen Sie die CMDB-Gesundheit.
• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater, indem Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in effektive ServiceNow-Lösungen übersetzen und architektonische Entscheidungen und Kompromisse an technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder klar kommunizieren.
• Führen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Platform Owner und Enterprise Architect die Richtung der Lösung, um die Ausrichtung auf Governance, Sicherheit und die gesamte Plattformstrategie sicherzustellen. Was du mitbringst
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, IT oder einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung, idealerweise in regulierten Unternehmensumgebungen.
• Über 8 Jahre praktische ServiceNow-Erfahrung in komplexen Organisationen mit anspruchsvollen Compliance- und Auditanforderungen.
• ServiceNow Zertifizierungen wie CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – obligatorisch.
• Starkes Verständnis der ServiceNow-Implementierungsstrategien und Best Practices.
• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – bevorzugt.
• CTA- oder CMA-Zertifizierungen – bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung mit KI – ein starkes Plus.
• Erfahrung mit Git – bevorzugt.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, sichere und konforme Integrationen sowie Workflows im Unternehmensmaßstab zu entwerfen.
• Erleben Sie die Entwicklung von CMDB-Modellen, die mit BMC Discovery in komplexe Unternehmensumgebungen und Governance-Frameworks integriert sind - bevorzugt.
