jobs.title: ServiceNow Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

ServiceNow Business Analyst

Warsaw |  Hybrid model | Reference 7870

We are looking for a ServiceNow Business Analyst to support the rollout and ongoing evolution of a greenfield ServiceNow platform and the transformation of service management capabilities at SIX. This is not a short-term or single-module role. It is a platform-focused position supporting the design and delivery of ServiceNow across multiple domains over time. The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner, Platform Architect and business stakeholders to translate prioritized demand into clear, structured requirements, ensuring solutions are scalable, OOTB-first and aligned with the long-term platform vision. Scope The role supports requirements and process design across several ServiceNow domains within a greenfield platform context, including: ITSM – must CSM – preferred CMDB / CSDM – preferred IRM / GRC – preferred HRSD – preferred The candidate does not need to be equally strong across all domains. Experience in several areas is sufficient.

What You Will Do

• gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements in collaboration with stakeholders across ITSM, CSM, CMDB/CSDM, IRM/GRC and HRSD

• run workshops to understand current-state processes, pain points, dependencies and future-state needs

• translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and supporting documentation

• support the transformation of processes from legacy tools and practices into the ServiceNow platform

• perform OOTB fit-gap analysis and challenge unnecessary customization early

• identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, redesign, phase or retire processes

• work closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, scope clarification and prioritization

• work closely with the Platform Architect to ensure requirements align with the target-state design and platform guardrails and do not introduce unnecessary customization

• support testing and UAT by preparing scenarios, clarifying defects and validating business outcomes

• maintain documentation including traceability, assumptions, decisions and current-state and future-state process maps

What You Bring

• 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role

• 2–3 years of experience working on ServiceNow implementations or ServiceNow-enabled transformations, with solid understanding and hands-on experience with ITSM

• experience across several domains such as CSM, IRM / GRC, CMDB/CSDM – a strong plus

• strong experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, user story writing and functional documentation within SDLC environments

• experience documenting current-state and future-state processes

• experience supporting UAT and business validation

• experience in greenfield platform implementations or transformation programs

• experience working in cross-functional environments and with platform governance and organizational change management (OCM)

• strong business analysis and process mapping skills

• good understanding of ServiceNow platform concepts and workflow-based solutions

• ability to translate ambiguous demand into clear, structured requirements

• strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills

• clear written and verbal communication

• ability to work across business, product, architecture and delivery teams

• serviceNow CSA – preferred

• iTIL Foundation – preferred

• experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or Lucidchart – preferred

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at  +48 538 562 645

.

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

• We value diversity, and the enrichment it brings to our company. We look forward to all applications, regardless of personal background.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• Lead the onboarding of early adopter teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems

• Work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• Build and maintain telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and alerting, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• Run and evolve observability services in Kubernetes environments, using Helm and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), integrating with ITSM, ticketing and event management systems

What You Bring

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, operating and supporting production systems

• Experience building or scaling observability capabilities, ideally in greenfield or early-stage environments, and turning requirements into working solutions

• Strong practical knowledge of modern observability practices, including OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

• Solid experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads using Helm and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

• Experience with common observability toolchains (such as Grafana and Elastic Stack), with scripting or automation skills considered a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8146

Dans cette position, vous serez propriétaire d'activités de clôture mensuelles et annuelles, assurant le respect des PCGR et des IFRS locales. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, préparerez des états financiers exacts pour les entités internationales et assumerez des tâches comptables mensuelles spécifiques telles que la TVA et la comptabilité des états de paie (SAP FI). Ce rôle est idéal pour quelqu'un avec au moins 2 ans d'expertise en comptabilité du grand livre général, un état d'esprit collaboratif et la capacité de travailler de façon autonome. Ce que vous ferez
• gérer les opérations comptables quotidiennes, y compris les écritures de réservation et de rapprochement, et diriger les clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles des entités affectées;
• préparer les états financiers conformément aux PCGR applicables et appuyer les processus de vérification externe
• le traitement de tâches comptables spécifiques, telles que la comptabilité de la TVA et des états de paie (SAP FI);
• collaborer avec divers ministères et partenaires externes pour assurer l'exactitude et la conformité des rapports Ce que vous apportez
• Diplôme en finance et comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe
• au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans un environnement de grand livre
• Connaissance approfondie des normes comptables (IFRS, GAAP internationaux) et des processus financiers
• expérience éprouvée dans SAP S4/hana
• excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et en polonais (l'allemand est un plus), avec un esprit d'équipe proactif et axé sur des résultats de qualité Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645 Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. C++ Software Engineer Madrid | Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7650 Are you interested in the world of Finance and IT? Do you have experience as a developer and enjoy working on innovative projects and services? Then, become part of our dynamic and collaborative development team and work on IT projects for the Exchanges Business Unit in Spain and Switzerland. • Develop backend applications using C++ / Linux stack.
• Ensure the operational service level and stability of application. Manage application lifecycle and budget.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, and CI/CD pipelines. What You Bring
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in C++ / Linux programming with accent on development of high-performance network servers.
• Experience in management of the application lifecycle, including development, maintenance, regulations, security and budget.

• Experience and knowledge of CI/CD (GitLab, Artifactory), Ansible, Linux Shell and Python programming.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a team and collaborative mindset.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . titleByLocale.fr: Visites guidées et événements BME Stage

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Guided Tours & BME Events Internship (Morning Schedule)

Madrid |  Flexible Working Model | Reference 8004

Are you studying and do you have skills in the field of events management, communication and public relations? Are you interested in the Communication and Marketing sector and looking for an interesting internship to learn more about financial sector?
If your answer is yes, our Events and Conferences team, responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a morning internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in the Events and Conferences area. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1).

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• carry out the guided tours, oversee mailbox and answer inquiries for guided tours, administrating and managing all incoming requests (mail/telephone)

• collaboration in the development of the materials and speeches for the guided tours, acquiring knowledge and history related to the stock market and its surroundings (Stock Exchange Palace)

• support the event managers in all aspects of event management (planning, preparing, execution, event material, invitation and registration management, etc.)

• provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work

• on-Site support at events

What You Bring

• studies in Marketing, Communication, Tourism, Bussines Administration or Event Organization

• ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills

• strong organizational skills and personal flexibility

• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills

• very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)

• experience in hosting virtual events is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office moeglich | Reference 7924

Möchtest du in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten und aktiv zur Sicherheit im Kartengeschäft beitragen? Dann verstärke unser Fraud Services Team.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8095

We are seeking a motivated Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst with a strong technical mindset to support the intelligence collection,  automation and maturation of our intelligence capabilities.

The focus of this role in Cyber Threat Intelligence is to enhance cyber threat intelligence capabilities through automation, AI-driven analysis, and continuous improvement of telemetry and intelligence workflows. You will work closely with senior team members and partners to enhance the company's intelligence capabilities.

This position is available only in Spain due to the restrictions of some of the intelligence sources.

What You Will Do

• Join an international Cyber Threat Intelligence team operating 24x7, including on-call availability when required.

• Monitor, collect, and analyze intelligence from restricted communities, internal telemetry, and monitoring systems to identify actionable insights and support investigations, incident response, and threat detection activities.

• Own and continuously improve weekly intelligence telemetry reporting, dashboards, and visualization capabilities to provide accurate, consistent, and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Contribute to the automation and orchestration of CTI workflows, including data collection, enrichment, analysis, reporting, and the integration of AI-driven capabilities for correlation, prioritization, and analytical output generation.

• Work with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security tooling, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms, and malware sandboxes, while applying frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to contextualize threats and improve detection effectiveness.

• Collaborate with SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security, and other cross-functional teams to operationalize intelligence insights, produce threat reports and executive summaries, and support the continuous improvement and scalability of CTI processes.

What You Bring

• 4 years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, incident response, SOC, or related technical cybersecurity roles.

• Strong technical profile with hands-on experience in automation, scripting, or orchestration

• Familiarity with AI applications in cybersecurity, particularly for automation, data processing, analytics, and intelligence workflow improvement.

• Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security monitoring tools, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM platforms, or similar technologies.

• Solid understanding of the intelligence lifecycle, telemetry analysis, tactical intelligence collection, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK for threat detection and analysis

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analizzatore di intelligenza minaccia Cyber

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8095

Stiamo cercando un motivato Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analista con una forte mentalità tecnica per supportare la raccolta di intelligenza, l'automazione e la maturazione delle nostre capacità di intelligenza.

Il focus di questo ruolo in Cyber Threat Intelligence è quello di migliorare le capacità di intelligenza delle minacce informatiche attraverso l'automazione, l'analisi guidata dall'IA e il miglioramento continuo dei flussi di lavoro di telemetria e intelligenza. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i membri del team senior e partner per migliorare le capacità di intelligenza dell'azienda.

Questa posizione è disponibile solo in Spagna a causa delle restrizioni di alcune fonti di intelligence.

Cosa farai

• Unisciti a un team internazionale di Cyber Threat Intelligence che opera 24x7, inclusa la disponibilità on-call quando necessario.

• Monitorare, raccogliere e analizzare l'intelligenza da comunità ristrette, telemetria interna e sistemi di monitoraggio per identificare intuizioni e indagini di supporto, risposta agli incidenti e attività di rilevamento delle minacce.

• Possedere e migliorare continuamente le funzionalità di reportistica, dashboard e visualizzazione dell'intelligenza settimanale per fornire informazioni accurate, coerenti e attuabili agli stakeholder.

• Contribuire all'automazione e all'orchestrazione dei flussi di lavoro CTI, tra cui la raccolta dei dati, l'arricchimento, l'analisi, la segnalazione e l'integrazione delle capacità basate su AI per la correlazione, la priorità e la generazione di output analitici.

• Lavora con Threat Intelligence Platforms e tooling di sicurezza, tra cui OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms e malware sandboxes, mentre applica framework come MITRE ATT&CK per contestualizzare le minacce e migliorare l'efficacia del rilevamento.

• Collabora con SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security e altri team interfunzionali per operare intuizioni di intelligence, produrre report di minacce e sintesi esecutive, e sostenere il continuo miglioramento e scalabilità dei processi CTI.

Che cosa porta

• 4 anni di esperienza in Cyber Threat Intelligence, risposta agli incidenti, SOC, o relativi ruoli di sicurezza informatica tecnica.

• Forte profilo tecnico con esperienza pratica nell'automazione, nella scrittura o nell'orchestrazione

• Familiarità con le applicazioni AI in sicurezza informatica, in particolare per l'automazione, l'elaborazione dei dati, l'analisi e il miglioramento del flusso di lavoro di intelligenza.

• Esperienza con Threat Intelligence Platforms e strumenti di monitoraggio della sicurezza, tra cui OpenCTI, Elastic stack, piattaforme SIEM o tecnologie simili.

• Solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dell'intelligenza, dell'analisi della telemetria, della raccolta di informazioni tattiche e delle strutture come MITRE ATT&CK per il rilevamento e l'analisi delle minacce

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8095

Wir suchen einen motivierten Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analysten mit einer starken technischen Denkweise, um die Sammlung, Automatisierung und Reifung unserer Intelligenzfähigkeiten zu unterstützen.

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle in Cyber Threat Intelligence liegt auf der Verbesserung der Cyber Threat Intelligence-Fähigkeiten durch Automatisierung, KI-gesteuerte Analyse und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Telemetrie- und Intelligenz-Workflows. Sie werden eng mit leitenden Teammitgliedern und Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um die Intelligenzfähigkeiten des Unternehmens zu verbessern.

Diese Position ist nur in Spanien aufgrund der Einschränkungen einiger Geheimdienstquellen verfügbar.

Was Sie tun werden

• Treten Sie einem internationalen Cyber Threat Intelligence-Team bei, das 24x7 arbeitet, einschließlich der Bereitschaftsverfügbarkeit bei Bedarf.

• Überwachen, Sammeln und Analysieren von Informationen aus eingeschränkten Gemeinschaften, internen Telemetrie- und Überwachungssystemen, um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren und Untersuchungen, Incident Response und Bedrohungserkennungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.

• Eigene und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der wöchentlichen Intelligence-Telemetrie-Berichte, Dashboards und Visualisierungsfunktionen, um den Stakeholdern genaue, konsistente und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu liefern.

• Tragen Sie zur Automatisierung und Orchestrierung von CTI-Workflows bei, einschließlich Datenerfassung, -anreicherung, -analyse, -berichterstattung und Integration von KI-gesteuerten Funktionen für Korrelation, Priorisierung und analytische Outputgenerierung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Threat Intelligence-Plattformen und Sicherheitstools, einschließlich OpenCTI, Elastic Stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence-Plattformen und Malware-Sandboxen, während Sie Frameworks wie MITRE ATT & CK anwenden, um Bedrohungen zu kontextualisieren und die Erkennungseffektivität zu verbessern.

• Arbeiten Sie mit SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Intelligence Insights zu operationalisieren, Bedrohungsberichte und Zusammenfassungen zu erstellen und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Skalierbarkeit von CTI-Prozessen zu unterstützen.

Was du mitbringst

• 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, SOC oder verwandten technischen Cybersicherheitsrollen.

• Starkes technisches Profil mit praktischer Erfahrung in Automatisierung, Scripting oder Orchestrierung

• Vertrautheit mit KI-Anwendungen in der Cybersicherheit, insbesondere für Automatisierung, Datenverarbeitung, Analyse und Workflow-Verbesserung.

• Erfahrung mit Threat Intelligence-Plattformen und Sicherheitsüberwachungstools, einschließlich OpenCTI, Elastic Stack, SIEM-Plattformen oder ähnlichen Technologien.

• Solides Verständnis des Intelligenzlebenszyklus, Telemetrieanalyse, taktische Intelligenzsammlung und Frameworks wie MITRE ATT & CK für Bedrohungserkennung und -analyse

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Yuliya Stoyko unter +34 917095993 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste du renseignement sur les cybermenaces

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8095

Nous recherchons un analyste motivé de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) doté d'un solide état d'esprit technique pour soutenir la collecte, l'automatisation et la maturation de nos capacités de renseignement.

Ce rôle dans Cyber Threat Intelligence est axé sur l'amélioration des capacités de renseignement sur les cybermenaces par l'automatisation, l'analyse axée sur l'IA et l'amélioration continue des flux de travail de télémétrie et de renseignement. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe senior et les partenaires pour améliorer les capacités de renseignement de l'entreprise.

Cette position n'est disponible qu'en Espagne en raison des restrictions de certaines sources de renseignement.

Ce que vous ferez

• Rejoignez une équipe internationale de Cyber Threat Intelligence fonctionnant 24x7, y compris la disponibilité sur appel au besoin.

• Surveiller, recueillir et analyser les renseignements provenant de collectivités restreintes, les systèmes de télémétrie interne et les systèmes de surveillance afin d'identifier les renseignements exploitables et de soutenir les enquêtes, les interventions en cas d'incident et les activités de détection des menaces.

• Sa propre capacité d'améliorer continuellement les rapports hebdomadaires de télémétrie, les tableaux de bord et la visualisation afin de fournir aux intervenants des renseignements précis, cohérents et exploitables.

• Contribuer à l'automatisation et à l'orchestration des flux de travail de l'ICT, y compris la collecte de données, l'enrichissement, l'analyse, l'établissement de rapports et l'intégration des capacités de corrélation, de hiérarchisation et de production de produits analytiques.

• Travailler avec Threat Intelligence Platforms et l'outillage de sécurité, y compris OpenCTI, Elastic Stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms et malware sandboxs, tout en appliquant des cadres tels que MITRE ATT&CK pour contextualiser les menaces et améliorer l'efficacité de la détection.

• Collaborer avec le COS, la détection et la chasse, la gestion de la vulnérabilité, la sécurité de l'entreprise et d'autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour rendre opérationnels les renseignements, produire des rapports sur les menaces et des résumés exécutifs, et appuyer l'amélioration continue et l'évolutivité des processus d'ICT.

Ce que vous apportez

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Legal Counsel

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7849

Are you passionate about the Spanish Stock Exchange and eager to deepen your expertise in the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructures and securities trading? Do you thrive on making an impact as a legal counsel to the Spanish financial center, helping to shape a resilient and competitive economy? If so, our Legal Team Exchanges wants to hear from you.

As part of SIX Group, a leading global financial services and market infrastructure provider, this role sits within the Legal function in a team dedicated to supporting the Business Unit Exchanges, one of the four core Business Units of SIX. BU Exchanges operates markets in Switzerland, Spain, and the UK, making this a truly international mission at the heart of European capital markets. Your primary focus will be on the Spanish Stock Exchange, working closely with colleagues across SIX Group to ensure consistent, harmonized, and robust legal support. You will collaborate with peers in Switzerland and the UK to deliver integrated solutions across jurisdictions.  You will join a small, international team of lawyers partnering with stakeholders across the business and with colleagues from Legal & Compliance and other corporate functions, contributing to strategic initiatives that shape the future of our markets.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Provide legal advice to the Business Unit Exchanges on a wide range of topics, from day-to-day matters to strategic, group-wide projects involving international collaboration.

• Analyze and assess business initiatives for their compliance with applicable laws, such as Spanish supervisory law (e. g. Securities Market and Investment Services Act), EU regulations (e. g. MIFID and MIFIR), competition law, contract law, and regulations of the Exchange (eg. Listing Rules or Trading Rules) and collaborate on contract related matters relevant to the Business Unit.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders across the Business Unit Exchanges and Corporate Functions and assess legal risks and provide recommendations on actions options within the regulatory framework of trading of securities such as equities, structured products, exchange traded funds or bonds.

• Prepare submissions to, and liaise with, CNMV, the Spanish regulator, as part of key interactions with authorities, and support the Business Unit Exchanges in its diverse and frequent dealings with CNMV.

• Company secretarial skills to assist with matters for Spanish incorporated entities assisting in liaising with board directors, key stakeholders and coordinating timely delivery of relevant and concise board papers.

What You Bring

• Master’s degree in Law and admission to the Spanish Bar; additional legal or regulatory qualifications are an advantage.

• 4–5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally at a law firm with exposure to financial regulation and company secretarial matters and/or as in‑house counsel in the financial sector.

• Pragmatic, solution‑oriented mindset, combining strong analytical skills with high quality standards and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic, fast‑changing environment.

• Strong interest in exchange business and financial market infrastructure, with the ambition to further specialize in exchange and securities law and to understand the technical aspects of market operations and trading processes.

• Business‑fluent English, both written and spoken; knowledge of German or Spanish is an advantage but not mandatory.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Consigliere legale senior

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 7849

Sei appassionato della Borsa di Spagna e desideroso di approfondire le tue competenze nel quadro normativo che disciplina le infrastrutture di mercato finanziario e il trading di titoli? Si prospera a fare un impatto come consulente legale al centro finanziario spagnolo, aiutando a plasmare un'economia resiliente e competitiva? Se è così, il nostro Legal Team Exchanges vuole sentire da voi.

Nell'ambito del Gruppo SIX, fornitore leader di servizi finanziari globali e di infrastrutture di mercato, questo ruolo si trova all'interno della funzione Legale in un team dedicato a sostenere gli Exchange Business Unit, una delle quattro core Business Unit di SIX. BU Exchange opera mercati in Svizzera, Spagna e Regno Unito, rendendo questa una vera e propria missione internazionale nel cuore dei mercati dei capitali europei. Il vostro focus principale sarà sulla Borsa di Spagna, lavorando a stretto contatto con colleghi di tutto il Gruppo SIX per garantire un supporto legale coerente, armonizzato e robusto. Potrai collaborare con i colleghi in Svizzera e nel Regno Unito per fornire soluzioni integrate attraverso le giurisdizioni. Ti unirai a un piccolo e internazionale team di avvocati che collaborano con gli stakeholder di tutto il business e con colleghi di Legal & Compliance e altre funzioni aziendali, contribuendo a iniziative strategiche che plasmano il futuro dei nostri mercati.

Ti sembra interessante? Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Fornire consulenza legale ai Business Unit Exchange su una vasta gamma di argomenti, da questioni quotidiane a progetti strategici e di gruppo che coinvolgono la collaborazione internazionale.

• Analizzare e valutare le iniziative di business per il loro rispetto delle leggi applicabili, come la legge di vigilanza spagnola (ad esempio Securities Market and Investment Services Act), le normative UE (ad esempio MIFID e MIFIR), il diritto di concorrenza, il diritto contrattuale e le normative dello scambio (ad esempio Regole di quotazione o Regole di Trading) e collaborare su questioni relative al contratto relative all'unità aziendale.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni attraverso gli scambi di business unit e le funzioni aziendali e valutare i rischi legali e fornire raccomandazioni sulle opzioni di azioni nel quadro normativo di trading di titoli come azioni, prodotti strutturati, fondi scambiati o obbligazioni.

• Preparare le sottomissioni a, e liaise con, CNMV, il regolatore spagnolo, come parte delle interazioni chiave con le autorità, e sostenere gli scambi di unità di affari nelle sue diverse e frequenti relazioni con CNMV.

• Competenze di segretariato aziendale per assistere con le questioni per gli enti spagnoli incorporati che aiutano a legare con i consiglieri, le parti interessate chiave e coordinare la consegna tempestiva di documenti di bordo pertinenti e concisi.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea magistrale in Giurisprudenza e ammissione al bar spagnolo; ulteriori qualifiche legali o regolamentari sono un vantaggio.

• 4-5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante, idealmente in uno studio legale con esposizione alla regolamentazione finanziaria e alle questioni di segreteria aziendale e/o come consulente interno nel settore finanziario.

• Pragmatic, mentalità orientata alla soluzione, combinando forti competenze analitiche con elevati standard di qualità e la capacità di gestire le priorità in un ambiente dinamico e in rapida evoluzione.

• Forte interesse per lo scambio di business e le infrastrutture di mercato finanziario, con l'ambizione di specializzarsi ulteriormente nel diritto dello scambio e dei titoli e di comprendere gli aspetti tecnici delle operazioni di mercato e dei processi di trading.

• Inglese influenzato dal business, sia scritto che parlato; la conoscenza del tedesco o dello spagnolo è un vantaggio ma non obbligatorio.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

BU Exchanges betreibt Märkte in der Schweiz, Spanien und Großbritannien und ist damit eine wirklich internationale Mission im Herzen der europäischen Kapitalmärkte. Ihr Hauptaugenmerk wird auf der spanischen Börse liegen und eng mit Kollegen der SIX Group zusammenarbeiten, um eine konsistente, harmonisierte und robuste rechtliche Unterstützung zu gewährleisten. Sie werden mit Kollegen in der Schweiz und Großbritannien zusammenarbeiten, um integrierte Lösungen in allen Jurisdiktionen zu liefern. Sie werden einem kleinen, internationalen Team von Anwälten beitreten, das mit Stakeholdern aus dem gesamten Unternehmen und mit Kollegen aus Legal & Compliance und anderen Unternehmensfunktionen zusammenarbeitet und zu strategischen Initiativen beiträgt, die die Zukunft unserer Märkte gestalten.

Klingt das für dich interessant? Zögern Sie nicht und bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit Ihrem Lebenslauf auf Englisch.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beratung der Business Unit Exchanges zu einer Vielzahl von Themen, von alltäglichen Angelegenheiten bis hin zu strategischen, gruppenweiten Projekten mit internationaler Zusammenarbeit.

• Analysieren und bewerten Sie Unternehmensinitiativen auf ihre Einhaltung geltender Gesetze, wie z. B. spanisches Aufsichtsrecht (z. B. Securities Market and Investment Services Act), EU-Vorschriften (z. B. MIFID und MIFIR), Wettbewerbsrecht, Vertragsrecht und Vorschriften der Börse (z. B. Listing Rules oder Handelsregeln) und arbeiten Sie in vertragsbezogenen Angelegenheiten zusammen, die für den Geschäftsbereich relevant sind.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Stakeholdern in der Business Unit Exchanges and Corporate Functions zusammen und bewerten Sie rechtliche Risiken und geben Sie Empfehlungen zu Handlungsoptionen im regulatorischen Rahmen des Wertpapierhandels wie Aktien, strukturierte Produkte, börsengehandelte Fonds oder Anleihen.

• Bereiten Sie Einreichungen bei CNMV, der spanischen Regulierungsbehörde, vor und arbeiten Sie mit ihr zusammen, als Teil der wichtigsten Interaktionen mit den Behörden, und unterstützen Sie die Business Unit Exchanges bei ihren vielfältigen und häufigen Geschäften mit CNMV.

• Unternehmenssekretariatskompetenzen zur Unterstützung von Angelegenheiten für in Spanien ansässige Unternehmen, die bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Vorstandsmitgliedern, wichtigen Stakeholdern und der Koordinierung der rechtzeitigen Lieferung relevanter und prägnanter Vorstandspapiere helfen.

Was du mitbringst

• Master-Abschluss in Rechtswissenschaften und Zulassung zur spanischen Rechtsanwaltskammer; zusätzliche rechtliche oder regulatorische Qualifikationen sind von Vorteil.

• 4–5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in einer Anwaltskanzlei mit Tätigkeit im Bereich Finanzregulierung und Betriebssekretariat und/oder als Inhouse Counsel im Finanzsektor.

• Pragmatisches, lösungsorientiertes Mindset, das starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit hohen Qualitätsstandards und der Fähigkeit verbindet, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen, sich schnell verändernden Umfeld zu verwalten.

• Starkes Interesse an Börsengeschäft und Finanzmarktinfrastruktur, mit dem Ziel, sich weiter auf das Devisen- und Wertpapierrecht zu spezialisieren und die technischen Aspekte von Marktoperationen und Handelsprozessen zu verstehen.

• Business fließendes Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen; Deutsch- oder Spanischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber nicht obligatorisch.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an.

Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Conseiller juridique principal

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% Référence 7849

Êtes-vous passionné par la Bourse espagnole et désireux d'approfondir votre expertise dans le cadre réglementaire régissant les infrastructures des marchés financiers et la négociation de valeurs mobilières? Est-ce que vous prospèrez en faisant un impact en tant que conseiller juridique au centre financier espagnol, aidant à façonner une économie résiliente et compétitive? Si oui, nos échanges d'équipes juridiques veulent vous entendre.

Dans le cadre de SIX Group, leader mondial des services financiers et fournisseur d'infrastructures de marché, ce rôle s'inscrit dans la fonction juridique d'une équipe dédiée au soutien des Business Unit Exchanges, l'une des quatre principales Business Units de SIX. BU Exchanges exploite des marchés en Suisse, en Espagne et au Royaume-Uni, ce qui en fait une véritable mission internationale au cœur des marchés financiers européens. Votre principal objectif sera la Bourse espagnole, en étroite collaboration avec des collègues du groupe SIX afin d'assurer un soutien juridique cohérent, harmonisé et solide. Vous collaborerez avec des pairs en Suisse et au Royaume-Uni pour fournir des solutions intégrées dans toutes les juridictions. Vous rejoindrez une petite équipe internationale d'avocats en partenariat avec des intervenants de l'ensemble de l'entreprise et avec des collègues de Legal & Compliance et d'autres fonctions corporatives, contribuant ainsi à des initiatives stratégiques qui façonnent l'avenir de nos marchés.

Ça vous paraît intéressant ? N'hésitez pas et appliquez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais.

Ce que vous ferez

• Fournir des conseils juridiques aux échanges d'unités d'affaires sur un large éventail de sujets, depuis les questions courantes jusqu'aux projets stratégiques à l'échelle du groupe faisant appel à la collaboration internationale.

• Analyser et évaluer les initiatives des entreprises en vue de leur conformité avec les lois applicables, telles que la législation espagnole en matière de surveillance (par exemple la loi sur les marchés de valeurs mobilières et les services d'investissement), les règlements de l'UE (par exemple la MIFID et la MIFIR), le droit de la concurrence, le droit des contrats et les règlements de la Bourse (par exemple, les règles de cotation ou les règles de négociation) et collaborer sur les questions liées aux contrats intéressant l'unité commerciale.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes dans l'ensemble de l'unité commerciale Échanges et fonctions d'entreprise et évaluer les risques juridiques et formuler des recommandations sur les mesures à prendre dans le cadre réglementaire de la négociation de titres tels que les actions, les produits structurés, les fonds négociés en bourse ou les obligations.

• Préparer les présentations et assurer la liaison avec le CNMV, l'organisme de réglementation espagnol, dans le cadre des principales interactions avec les autorités, et appuyer les échanges de services commerciaux dans ses relations diverses et fréquentes avec le CNMV.

• Compétences de secrétariat de l'entreprise pour aider les entités constituées en espagnol à assurer la liaison avec les directeurs du conseil d'administration, les principales parties prenantes et à coordonner la livraison en temps voulu de documents pertinents et concis.

Ce que vous apportez

• Maîtrise en droit et admission au barreau espagnol; des qualifications juridiques ou réglementaires supplémentaires sont un avantage.

• De 4 à 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente, idéalement dans un cabinet d'avocats qui est exposé aux questions de réglementation financière et de secrétariat d'entreprise et/ou comme conseiller interne dans le secteur financier.

• Un état d'esprit pragmatique, axé sur la solution, combinant de solides compétences analytiques avec des normes de qualité élevées et la capacité de gérer les priorités dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

• Intérêt marqué pour les échanges commerciaux et l'infrastructure des marchés financiers, avec l'ambition de se spécialiser davantage dans le droit des changes et des valeurs mobilières et de comprendre les aspects techniques des opérations de marché et des processus de négociation.

• La connaissance de l'allemand ou de l'espagnol est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home | Reference 7950

The Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day operation of the Cyber Security Resilience services, with a strong focus on service desk activities, operational follow-up, and audit support.

The role acts as the first operational layer for File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB), and Vulnerability Management, relieving senior engineers and analysts from administrative, evidentiary, and coordination tasks while ensuring consistency, quality, and audit readiness.

What You Will Do

• Operational & Service Desk Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for service desk requests and tickets related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB / CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management activities

• Triage, track, and coordinate operational tickets, ensuring timely handling and clear communication with stakeholders.

• Perform initial analysis and validation of findings (e.g. expected vs. unexpected changes, status of vulnerabilities, baseline deviations) before escalation.

• Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and FAQs related to Cyber Security Resilience services.

• Tool-Based Operational Activities

• Operate and support Cyber Security Resilience tooling on a daily basis, including retrieving data, validating results, and supporting reporting activities.

• Assist in maintaining data quality and consistency across FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management tools.

• Support recurring operational tasks such as: Report generation, Status checks, Evidence extraction, Follow-up tracking

• This role is not responsible for tool engineering, rule development, or architecture, but requires a solid understanding of how the tools work and how results should be interpreted.

• Audit & Compliance Support

• Actively support internal and external audit activities (e.g. FINMA, DORA, internal audits) by extracting audit evidence directly from Cyber Security Resilience tools, ensuring evidence is complete, traceable, and aligned with audit requests, supporting responses to audit questions in coordination with senior team members.

• Maintain structured audit evidence repositories and support continuous audit readiness.

• Help standardise and streamline evidence collection processes to reduce broader team workload.

• Coordination & Stakeholder Support

• Liaise with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams on operational clarifications and ticket follow-ups.

• Support the Cyber Security Resilience team by absorbing operational overhead, allowing engineers and specialists to focus on analysis and improvement initiatives.

• Escalate operational risks, recurring issues, or data gaps to senior team members in a structured manner.

What You Bring

• Solid foundational understanding of cyber security concepts, particularly: Vulnerability management, Secure system configuration / CIS Benchmarks, File integrity and change monitoring

• Hands-on experience working with security or infrastructure tooling, ideally in an operational or service-oriented role.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, SLAs, and operational support models.

• Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, or evidence collection is a strong advantage.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable in execution.

• Comfortable working with operational data, evidence, and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality.

• Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proactive in identifying inefficiencies or improvement opportunities in operational processes.

• English Fluency

• German advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Support Agent

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7872

In this hybrid role you handle day-to-day customer requests while driving automation and continuous improvement. You ensure high-quality ticket handling, spot patterns, and help reduce avoidable tickets through AI-assisted solutions and workflow optimization.

What You Will Do

• handle recurring and standard tickets with accuracy and customer focus; ensure correct categorization and data quality

• prepare clear, structured escalations and maintain the knowledge base and contribute to documentation (ServiceNow)

• analyze tickets to identify automation candidates. support routing and classification logic and prompt design

• monitor automation outcomes and recommend enhancements.

• contribute to recurring reporting and simple dashboards

What You Bring

• 1–3 years in support/service operations or a related customer-facing role; fluent English and in French

• experience supporting or participating in AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives is a plus

• customer-first mindset with strong process adherence, proactive approach, attention to detail, and a focus on quality

• analytical curiosity with the ability to identify patterns, solve problems, and drive improvements

• experience in f inancial services, banking, fintech, or capital markets

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Agente di assistenza clienti Varsavia | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 7872 In questo ruolo ibrido gestisci le richieste quotidiane del cliente mentre guida l'automazione e il miglioramento continuo. Garantisci una gestione dei biglietti di alta qualità, modelli spot, e contribuire a ridurre i biglietti evitabili attraverso soluzioni assistite dall'IA e l'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro. Cosa farai
• gestire i biglietti ricorrenti e standard con accuratezza e attenzione al cliente; garantire una corretta categorizzazione e qualità dei dati
• preparare escalazioni chiare e strutturate e mantenere la base di conoscenza e contribuire alla documentazione (ServiceNow)
• analizzare i biglietti per identificare i candidati all'automazione. supporto routing e logica di classificazione e progettazione rapida
• monitorare i risultati dell'automazione e consigliare miglioramenti.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Treasury Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8013

Are you an experienced Treasury Manager with IT affinity? Are you familiar with the treasury related tasks in the day-to-day operations, especially cash management and FX hedging? Do you want to further develop these activities and processes and bring in your expertise? Then apply as a Treasury Manager to join our treasury team in Zurich.

Our Treasury team is looking for a Treasury Manager to support and oversee treasury operations and financial risk management activities across the organization. In this role, you will act as a key link between Treasury, Finance, Banking Partners, and other internal stakeholders. You will contribute to efficient cash and liquidity management, support strategic treasury initiatives, and help ensure transparency, compliance, and consistency across all treasury processes.

What You Will Do

• Take responsibility in the day-to-day treasury operations (e.g. cash management, bank relationship management, hedging, etc.)

• Maintain and develop the Treasury Management System

• Foster collaboration with in- and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to optimize treasury activities and processes

• Participate in strategic treasury projects of SIX Group

What You Bring

• Degree in business administration, finance/accounting or related studies, further qualifications are a plus

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a treasury / corporate finance / cash management function, preferably in an international environment

• Solid understanding of day-to-day treasury operations such as cash and liquidity management, interest- and FX hedging, intercompany financing, liability management and bank relationship management (including KYC-documentation)

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent organizational skills

• IT affinity / experience with treasury management systems (preferably ITS from Reval/ION, SAP and 360T)

• Very good language skills in German and English (verbal and writing), Spanish is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Project Manager

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8154

Are you passionate about steering enterprise-wide IT initiatives across their full lifecycle—reducing complexity, increasing resilience, and delivering measurable business value? We are seeking a Senior IT Project Manager for our Corporate Function IT (CIT) to lead international, cross-functional projects in infrastructure , operations , compliance, and security in an international team. You will drive migrations, modernizations, and harmonization programs, establish robust governance, and help the organization sustainably adopt standards and new solutions.

What You Will Do

• lead and deliver complex end-to-end IT projects across infrastructure, operations, compliance, and security in regulated environments

• plan and execute migrations, decommissioning, and cutovers, ensuring data integrity, integrations, and risk control

• establish and enforce governance, audit, and security standards; provide transparent steering and management reporting

• drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and communication to enable adoption and standardization

• coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors; prepare decision papers and materials for boards and committees

What You Bring

• 10+ years of IT project management experience (ideally in financial or other regulated environments) with proven delivery in infrastructure, compliance, and operations

• certifications in PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent; strong, pragmatic use of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) in hybrid setups

• proficiency with Jira/Confluence, Jira Service Management, Office 365, Planisware, and risk management tools; familiarity with BMC ITSM Suite, Enterprise Architect, access management, and firewall/network tools

• excellent analytical and conceptual skills with structured problem-solving, clear communication, and strong stakeholder/change management; high initiative, organization, and assertiveness with empathy and EQ

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior IT Project Manager

Warsaw | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8154

Are you passionate about steering enterprise-wide IT initiatives across their full lifecycle—reducing complexity, increasing resilience, and delivering measurable business value? We are seeking a Senior IT Project Manager for our Corporate Function IT (CIT) to lead international, cross-functional projects in infrastructure , operations , compliance, and security in an international team. You will drive migrations, modernizations, and harmonization programs, establish robust governance, and help the organization sustainably adopt standards and new solutions.

What You Will Do

• lead and deliver complex end-to-end IT projects across infrastructure, operations, compliance, and security in regulated environments

• plan and execute migrations, decommissioning, and cutovers, ensuring data integrity, integrations, and risk control

• establish and enforce governance, audit, and security standards; provide transparent steering and management reporting

• drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and communication to enable adoption and standardization

• coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors; prepare decision papers and materials for boards and committees

What You Bring

• 10+ years of IT project management experience (ideally in financial or other regulated environments) with proven delivery in infrastructure, compliance, and operations

• certifications in PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent; strong, pragmatic use of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) in hybrid setups

• proficiency with Jira/Confluence, Jira Service Management, Office 365, Planisware, and risk management tools; familiarity with BMC ITSM Suite, Enterprise Architect, access management, and firewall/network tools

Olten |  Onsite | Reference 7835

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Développeur d'applications (80-100%) Oltène sur place Référence 7835 Êtes-vous passionné par la technologie moderne et la construction d'applications haute performance? prospèrez-vous dans un environnement agile où la collaboration, la confiance et la propriété sont importantes? Rejoignez notre équipe de développement d'applications et aidez à fournir des solutions innovantes et de haute qualité à nos clients. En tant que concepteur d'applications et développeur principal, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux et informatiques, concevoirez des solutions de qualité entreprise et jouerez un rôle actif dans l'orientation et l'exécution des tâches clés de développement. Ce que vous ferez
• Construisez des systèmes Web et de base évolutives pour les activités post-trading de SIX.
• Moderniser et maintenir les applications d'entreprise et les services Web existants.
• Collaborer avec les propriétaires de produits et les architectes pour définir des solutions et maintenir la documentation technique.
• Effectuer des examens, appliquer les pratiques exemplaires, assurer la sécurité et la conformité à la réglementation et fournir des conseils techniques aux équipes de développement.
• Promouvoir l'automatisation des processus de développement, y compris les pipelines CI/CD, et favoriser la communication ouverte au sein de l'équipe. Ce que vous apportez
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la conception, le développement et le maintien des applications d'entreprise.
• De solides compétences en Java (OpenJDK), Spring Boot et Angular; expérimenté avec OpenShift, GitLab, Ansible, Tomcat et WildFly; et expérience pratique de travail avec des bases de données relationnelles.
• Capacité de diriger et de soutenir des équipes de développement avec des conseils techniques tout en contribuant activement en tant que développeur principal.
• Connaissance des pratiques de codage sécurisé et des principes de sécurité du Web.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); l'allemand et/ou l'espagnol sont un plus. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . jobs.title: IT Commercial Coordinator
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Commercial Coordinator

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8015

Are you passionate about IT technologies and interested in working in a highly dynamic environment? Join the Costs & Vendors team, where you will help manage costs and compliance for our global IT infrastructure and workplace. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver services for the global IT of SIX.

What You Will Do

• Support the financial steering of global IT infrastructure products (budget planning, forecasting, cost transparency)

• Act as a single point of contact for internal stakeholders and coordinate IT procurement requests and clarifications

• Support contract and license management activities (renewal tracking, documentation, basic compliance checks)

• Prepare reports and maintain operational processes (purchase orders, demand verification, renewals, documentation)

What You Bring

• First experience in IT product management, service-, contract- or license management

• Basic financial understanding (budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation) and strong attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills and interest in IT infrastructure and how services are delivered

• Willingness to learn licensing models and understand their commercial impact

• Skilled in Power BI reporting, automation and the use of artificial intelligence

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German and/or Spanish are a plus

• Growth mindset, open to change, and motivated to take on more responsibility step-by-step

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
